entries.src: 112年學測 Q5、105年學測 Q6、102年指考 Q4、87年聯考 Q7

essay.p1: If I won two million dollars in the lottery, I would help an organization that holds camps at small schools in remote areas. Last winter, I helped out at one of its camps. Small schools have few teachers, so these teachers often teach subjects they never studied, like music and art. If students never get a chance to try these subjects, they may never find out what they are good at. This means they will have fewer choices.
essay.p2: Our camp gave them that chance. We taught art, music, and PE as well as math and science. On the second day, a quiet boy picked up some drumsticks and did not want to put them down. With the money, the organization could hold more camps so that more students like him could discover what they love.

zh.p1: 如果我買樂透中了兩百萬元，我會把錢拿去幫助一個組織，這個組織專門到偏鄉小校辦營隊。去年寒假，我就在這個組織辦的一個營隊幫過忙。這種小校的老師很少，所以這些老師常常教到自己沒學過的科目，像是音樂和美術。學生如果一直沒有機會試試這些科目，可能永遠不知道自己擅長什麼，這也就表示，他們能選的路會比較少。
zh.p2: 我們的營隊就給了他們這個機會。除了數學和自然，我們也教美術、音樂和體育。第二天，一個很安靜的男生拿起鼓棒，就不想放下了。有了這筆錢，這個組織就能多辦幾個營隊，讓更多像他一樣的學生找到自己喜歡的事情。

basic.levels: 用字：三級只有 remote（偏遠的）一個。lottery（樂透）是六級，但這是題目本身給的字，所以照樣使用；PE 是 physical education（體育課）的縮寫，physical 是四級，可是 PE 是學生天天講的說法，Merriam-Webster 也收了這個縮寫，所以照樣使用。除此之外沒有四級以上的字。

upgrade.t: 用 who 和 which 把兩句併成一句
upgrade.b: If students never get a chance to try these subjects, they may never find out what they are good at. This means they will have fewer choices.
upgrade.m: Students who never get a chance to try these subjects may never find out what they are good at, which leaves them with fewer choices later.
upgrade.why: 基礎版先用 If 子句講條件，再另起一句，用 This 回指前面整件事。範文寫成 [Students] + who + [never get a chance to try these subjects]，who 代替 Students 當子句的主詞，同時又像連接詞一樣把「哪些學生」接進句子裡，所以不必再寫 if。句尾的 , which + [leaves them with fewer choices later] 指的不是前面某一個名詞，而是前面整件事；關係子句指整個句子或子句時，一律用 which 開頭，而且這是非限定子句，寫作時前面要加逗號。leave + [人] + with + [名詞] 表示某件事讓人落到某種處境，這裡就是「讓他們將來能選的路變少」。

upgrade.t: 用 not only … but also 把兩組科目並排
upgrade.b: We taught art, music, and PE as well as math and science.
upgrade.m: We offered not only math and science but also art, music, and PE.
upgrade.why: 兩句說的是同一件事：除了數學和自然，營隊還有美術、音樂和體育。基礎版寫成 [art, music, and PE] + as well as + [math and science]，as well as 的意思是「除了……之外，還有……」。範文用 not only (math and science) but also (art, music, and PE)，not only 和 but also 後面接的都是名詞，結構對稱。not only … but also 多用在比較正式的文字，很適合寫作文。

upgrade.t: would not 寫出「不肯」
upgrade.b: On the second day, a quiet boy picked up some drumsticks and did not want to put them down.
upgrade.m: On the second day, a quiet boy picked up a pair of drumsticks and would not put them down.
upgrade.why: 基礎版的 did not want to 是「不想」。範文用 would not + [原形動詞]，would 在這裡是 will 的過去式，表示過去願不願意做某件事，would not 就是「不肯」；Cambridge 的例句 he said he wouldn't (= he refused) 就是這個意思。也就是說，基礎版只說男孩不想放下，範文的 would not 則帶有拒絕的意思。另外，put 的受詞是 them 這類代名詞時，一定要放在 put 和 down 中間：put (them) down，不寫 put down them。

upgrade.t: 用 all that money 呼應開頭的兩百萬元
upgrade.b: With the money, the organization could hold more camps so that more students like him could discover what they love.
upgrade.m: With all that money, the organization could hold more camps like ours, so that more students like him could discover what they love.
upgrade.why: that 可以用來接著談前面已經提過的事情，這裡指的就是開頭那兩百萬元；all 是「全部」，(all) (that money) 合起來就是「這一整筆錢」，正好呼應題目說的全數金額。camps like ours 說明要多辦的是像我們這樣的營隊，把最後的假設和自己的經驗接了起來。

frames.name: 第一段（要幫助的對象和原因）

items.f: If I won two million dollars in the lottery, I would help ___（要幫助的機構或團體） that ___（這個機構在做的事情）.
items.ex: If I won two million dollars in the lottery, I would help a group that brings free meals to older people living alone.

items.f: Many ___（需要幫助的人） cannot ___（做不到的事情） because ___（原因）.
items.ex: Many older people living alone cannot cook for themselves because they are too weak.

items.f: As a result, ___（造成的結果）.
items.ex: As a result, some of them often skip meals.

items.f: Without help, ___（需要幫助的人） may never ___（沒有機會做的事情）.
items.ex: Without help, these older people may never see a doctor when they get sick.

frames.name: 第二段（親身經驗，以及這筆錢能帶來的改變）

items.f: I know this because I once ___（自己做過的事情）.
items.ex: I know this because I once helped deliver meals to older people in my neighborhood.

items.f: I will never forget the ___（某個人） who ___（他做了什麼事情）.
items.ex: I will never forget the grandmother who held my hand and thanked me again and again.

items.f: With all that money, ___（機構） could ___（能多做的事情） so that ___（受幫助的人能得到什麼）.
items.ex: With all that money, the group could hire more drivers so that hot meals could reach more homes.

items.f: ___（這筆錢能帶來的東西） would mean a lot to ___（受幫助的人） because ___（原因）.
items.ex: A hot meal would mean a lot to these older people because it is often the only meal they eat all day.

items.officialTitle: Something Interesting about a Classmate of Mine
items.prompt: 請以 “Something Interesting about a Classmate of Mine” 為題，寫出有關你一位同學的一件趣事。這位同學可以是你任何時期的同學，例如中學、小學或幼稚園的同學。
items.source: 大學入學考試中心 90 學年度學科能力測驗英文考科

essay.p1: The loudest sound I have ever heard in an English class did not come from anyone's mouth. It came from my classmate Kai, and it happened in the middle of a speaking lesson in our first year of senior high. Kai was a quiet boy who sat in the back row and seldom raised his hand, so nobody expected him to become the star of that lesson.
essay.p2: That day, we were practicing a dialogue about seeing the school nurse. Our teacher, Ms. Lin, asked Kai to play a student who felt sick, and she chose me to be the nurse. Kai walked slowly to the front, held his stomach, and read his line from the script: "I have a terrible stomachache." The moment he finished, a loud noise came from where he was standing. Everyone knew at once what had happened: Kai had passed gas, right in front of the whole class. For a second, the room was completely silent. Then everyone burst out laughing. Kai's face flushed with embarrassment, but instead of running back to his seat, he looked at me and said, "See? I'm not acting." That made us laugh even harder. Ms. Lin laughed so hard that tears came to her eyes. When she finally calmed down, she wrote "cut the cheese" on the board and explained that it was American slang for passing gas. "You may hear it in movies," she said, "but never use it in your essays." Today, none of us can remember a single line from that dialogue, but all of us remember that expression. Whenever anyone in our class says they have a stomachache, we look at each other and try hard not to laugh. Kai is still quiet, but since that day, we have all known how quickly he can turn an awkward moment into a joke.
essay.caveat:
這是一種寫法，不是標準答案。題目要求「文長120字左右」，這裡的「字」指的是英文單字（words），不是中文字數；91 學測起，原卷才寫成「120個單詞(words)」。這一年大考中心沒有公布評分說明，看不出多寫會不會扣分；本篇寫了 306 個單詞，篇幅與本題庫其他範文相近，是為了把事情的經過和每個人的反應都寫具體。
題目要寫的是「一件」趣事，所以本篇只寫一堂英文課上發生的事，沒有把這位同學的各種特點一一列出來。第一段只用一句交代阿凱平常的樣子（安靜、坐最後一排、很少舉手），是為了讓讀者看出，他後來那句話有多出人意料。好笑的地方也不在放屁本身，而在阿凱當下的反應：他沒有躲回座位，反而用一句話化解了尷尬。寫同學的趣事，最好也寫到當事人怎麼面對，不要只是拿同學出糗來開玩笑。
文中的 cut the cheese 是美式俚語，意思是放屁，而且不太禮貌；本篇只讓它出現在老師說的話裡，老師也交代了不能寫進作文。敘述的部分用的是 pass gas，這是比較客氣的說法，寫作文時要用這一個。這一年的題目沒有規定要分幾段，本篇第一段交代人物，第二段寫事情的經過，是為了讓讀者看得出兩件事的分界，不是題目的要求。大考中心自 98 年起才公布作文佳作，這一年沒有官方佳作可以對照。

zh.p1: 我在英文課上聽過最響的一個聲音，不是從誰的嘴巴發出來的。聲音來自我的同學阿凱，那是高一的一堂口說課上到一半發生的事情。阿凱平常很安靜，坐在最後一排，很少舉手，所以誰也沒想到，那堂課的主角會是他。
zh.p2: 那天我們在練習一段到健康中心看病的對話。林老師請阿凱演一個身體不舒服的學生，又要我演護理師。阿凱慢慢走到台前，抱著肚子，照著劇本唸出他的台詞：「我肚子痛得不得了。」話才說完，他站的地方就傳出很響的一聲。大家馬上就知道發生了什麼事：阿凱在全班面前放了一個屁。教室安靜了一秒鐘，接著大家哄堂大笑。阿凱臉都紅了，可是他沒有跑回座位，反而看著我說：「你看，我不是在演。」這一句讓大家笑得更厲害，林老師笑到眼淚都流出來了。等她好不容易平靜下來，就在黑板上寫下 cut the cheese，說這是美國的俚語，意思就是放屁。她說：「你們看電影可能會聽到，可是寫作文千萬別用。」到現在，那段對話我們連一句都不記得了，那個說法卻每個人都記得。只要班上有人說肚子痛，大家就會互看一眼，拚命忍住不笑。阿凱還是一樣安靜，可是從那天起，我們都知道，他三兩下就能把尷尬的場面變成笑話。

rubric.intro:
90 學測的英文作文，大考中心沒有公布評分說明，也沒有公布佳作，所以這一題沒有官方資料可以對照。題目本身的要求有三項：「文長120字左右」、以 “Something Interesting about a Classmate of Mine” 為題，以及寫出有關你一位同學的一件趣事。
下面的五項對照，借用大考中心從 95 學測起公布的評分項目，逐項說明範文怎麼寫；這五項不是 90 這一年公布的規定，所以這裡不寫配分。
rubric.keypoint:
題目要的是「一件」趣事：重點放在一件事情上，不是介紹這位同學的全部。趣事要讓讀者自己看出好笑在哪裡，所以要把當時的場面寫具體——大家在做什麼、誰說了什麼、其他人有什麼反應——而不是只寫一句 It was very funny。
題目說這位同學可以是任何時期的同學；不管寫哪個時期，都要讓讀者知道是什麼時候的事。本篇在第一段就交代，是高一的一堂英文口說課。
時態跟著內容走：第一句說的是到現在為止聽過最響的聲音，用現在完成式（have ever heard）；事情的經過用過去式；大家「知道」發生了什麼事，而放屁發生在知道之前，所以用過去完成式（had happened、had passed）；最後寫到現在，用現在式（can remember、is still quiet）；從那天起一直到現在都知道，用現在完成式（have known）。

mapping.t: 第一段交代人物與時間：阿凱是我的同學，事情發生在高一的一堂英文口說課；再用一句寫他平常的樣子——安靜、坐最後一排、很少舉手。第二段寫事情的經過，每一步都有具體的動作與對白：大家在練習到健康中心看病的對話，老師要阿凱演身體不舒服的學生、我演護理師；阿凱抱著肚子唸出 I have a terrible stomachache，話才說完就放了一個屁；教室安靜一秒後，大家哄堂大笑；阿凱臉紅，卻說 See? I'm not acting；老師笑到流眼淚，接著在黑板上寫下 cut the cheese，並交代作文不能用。最後寫到現在：那段對話沒有人記得，那個俚語每個人都記得；只要有人說肚子痛，大家就忍著不笑。

第一段第一句 The loudest sound I have ever heard in an English class did not come from anyone's mouth 先不說破是什麼聲音，讓讀者想知道答案；第二句點出人物與時間；第三句寫阿凱平常的樣子，並用 nobody expected him to become the star of that lesson 預告他後來的表現。
第二段照事情發生的先後寫：That day, we were practicing … → The moment he finished … → For a second, the room was completely silent → Then everyone burst out laughing → When she finally calmed down …。接著用 Today 從那一天跳到現在，寫這件事留下了什麼。最後一句 Kai is still quiet 呼應第一段的 Kai was a quiet boy，再加上從那天起大家才知道的另一面；讀到這裡，讀者也就明白第一段為什麼說誰也沒想到主角會是他。

[The loudest sound] [I have ever heard in an English class] did not come from anyone's mouth：最高級 + 省略 that 的關係子句 + have ever + p.p.，意思是「……過最……的」；聽過的聲音算到現在為止，所以用現在完成式。
Kai was a quiet boy [who sat in the back row and seldom raised his hand]：關係子句裡的兩個動詞 sat、raised 共用主詞 who。
nobody [expected] him [to become] the star of that lesson：expect + O + to V；後面的 asked Kai to play a student 是同一個句型。
Kai (walked slowly to the front), (held his stomach), and (read his line)：三個動作並列，前兩個後面加逗號，最後一個前面加 and。
[The moment] he finished, …：the moment + 子句，意思是「一……就……」，用法等於 as soon as。
a loud noise came from [where he was standing]：where 子句當介系詞 from 的受詞。
Everyone knew at once [what had happened]: Kai [had passed] gas：大家知道是在聽到聲音之後，放屁發生在知道之前，所以兩處都用過去完成式；冒號後面的句子說明冒號前面的 what had happened。
Then everyone [burst out laughing]：burst out + V-ing，意思是「突然……起來」；也可以說 burst into laughter。
[instead of] running back to his seat：instead of + V-ing，意思是「沒有……，反而……」。
"See? I'm not acting."：現在進行式，說的是說話當下正在做的事。
Ms. Lin laughed [so] hard [that] tears came to her eyes：so + 副詞 + that 子句，意思是「……到……的程度」。
explained that it was American slang [for] passing gas：slang for + 名詞或 V-ing，意思是「指……的俚語」；explained 是過去式，that 子句跟著用 was。
none of us can remember [a single line] from that dialogue：a single + 單數名詞用在否定句，強調「連一個都沒有」。none of us 當主詞時，接的是複數代名詞，動詞用單數、複數都有人用，正式寫作多用單數；本句用助動詞 can，不受影響。
[Whenever] anyone in our class says [they] have a stomachache：anyone 可以用 they 來指，動詞仍用複數形 have；《芝加哥格式手冊》第 18 版 5.51 已接受這個用法用於正式文章。
we look at each other and try hard [not] to laugh：不定詞的否定，not 放在 to 前面。
[since that day], we [have] all [known] how quickly he can [turn] an awkward moment [into] a joke：since + 過去的時間點，主要子句用現在完成式；how quickly … 是名詞子句，當 known 的受詞；turn A into B，意思是「把 A 變成 B」。

全篇實詞逐字對過大考中心《高中英文參考詞彙表》：已標級數的詞形之中，一級 129、二級 18、三級 4、四級 2、五級 1、六級 1，四級以上 4 個，占 155 個詞形的 2.6%，是 embarrassment（尷尬）、flushed（臉變紅，原形 flush）兩個四級字，五級的 script（劇本），以及六級的 slang（俚語）。三級的有 awkward、gas、senior、stomach；二級的有 dialogue、stomachache、expression、silent、seldom、whenever 等。
片語：come from（從……來）、in the middle of（在……的中間）、sit in the back row（坐在最後一排）、read one's line from the script（照著劇本唸台詞）、raise one's hand（舉手）、pass gas（放屁）、at once（立刻）、burst out laughing（突然大笑起來）、flush with embarrassment（尷尬得臉紅）、instead of（沒有……反而）、calm down（平靜下來）、look at each other（互相看一眼）、try not to（盡量不）、turn A into B（把 A 變成 B）。cut the cheese 也是放屁的意思，但是美式俚語，而且不太禮貌，只在口語裡用；寫作文要用 pass gas。這一篇容易拼錯的是 stomachache、dialogue、embarrassment、awkward、whenever 這幾個。

90 這一年大考中心沒有公布評分說明；97 學測表 1 寫明，體例看的是格式、標點與大小寫。本題題目給了標題，考試時可以照題目的寫法把 Something Interesting about a Classmate of Mine 寫在第一行；本題庫的範文只列兩段正文。本篇對白多，要留意引號的用法：引號裡的句子以大寫開頭，句號、逗號放在引號裡面（《芝加哥格式手冊》6.9），例如 "I have a terrible stomachache."；一句話中間插入 she said 的時候，前半句的逗號放在引號裡面，後半句接著用小寫，例如 "You may hear it in movies," she said, "but never use it in your essays."；提到 cut the cheese 這個說法本身時，也加上引號。另外，Ms. 後面加句點是美式寫法；三個以上的項目並列時，and 前面也加逗號（walked slowly to the front, held his stomach, and read his line）；practicing 是美式拼法，英式拼作 practising，本題庫的英文一律用美式。

wordBank.note: 條目取自本題庫的歷屆試題，缺口由本題庫補足；出處欄標示這個條目考過的年度與題號，練習句是本題庫依試題文體、針對這一題的情境寫的。先看中文自己寫寫看，想不出來再點提示，寫完再看參考答案。

groups.name: 活用型單字（Words for Production）
groups.note: 這一題要自己寫得出來的

entries.zh: 幽默感（have a good sense of humor 很有幽默感）
把 A 誤認成 B

entries.src: 112年學測 Q1、101年指考 Q3、98年學測 Q6、97年學測 Q5

sentences.zh: 我國中同學 Jerry 很有幽默感。
sentences.en: My junior high classmate Jerry had a great sense of humor.

sentences.zh: 有一次上歷史課，他上到一半就打起瞌睡來。
sentences.en: Once, halfway through a history class, he dozed off.

sentences.zh: 他突然說起夢話：「媽，再讓我睡五分鐘！」
sentences.en: Suddenly, he started talking in his sleep: "Mom, just five more minutes!"

sentences.zh: 坐他旁邊的同學先是咯咯地笑，接著全班都忍不住笑了出來。
sentences.en: The student next to him started giggling, and then the whole class burst out laughing.

sentences.zh: 老師假裝是他媽媽，溫柔地說：「好，再五分鐘。」
sentences.en: Our teacher pretended to be his mom and said softly, "OK, five more minutes."

sentences.zh: 他醒來發現大家都在看他，臉一下子就紅了。
sentences.en: When he woke up and found everyone looking at him, he blushed.

sentences.zh: 那一刻真的很尷尬，可是他自己也笑了出來。
sentences.en: It was a really awkward moment, but he couldn't help laughing too.

sentences.zh: 從那天起，「再五分鐘」就成了他的綽號。
sentences.en: From that day on, his nickname was "Five More Minutes."

sentences.zh: 到現在開同學會，大家還是會拿這件事取笑他。
sentences.en: Even now, at class reunions, we still tease him about it.

sentences.zh: 每次想起那一幕，我還是覺得好笑極了。
sentences.en: Whenever I think of that scene, I still find it hilarious.

sentences.zh: 小學時，我們班有個同學很會模仿老師說話的語氣。
sentences.en: In elementary school, one of my classmates was good at imitating our teachers' voices.

sentences.zh: 他說話很幽默，連校長聽了他的笑話都笑了。
sentences.en: He was so humorous that even the principal laughed at his jokes.

sentences.zh: 愚人節那天，我們把講桌上的粉筆全部藏起來，捉弄導師。
sentences.en: On April Fools' Day, we played a joke on our homeroom teacher by hiding all the chalk on her desk.

sentences.zh: 剛開學時，我把新來的英文老師誤認成學姊。
sentences.en: At the beginning of the semester, I mistook our new English teacher for an older student.
bold: mistook our new English teacher for an older student

sentences.zh: 我還問她：「你也找不到教室嗎？」真的好丟臉。
sentences.en: I even asked her, "Can't you find the classroom either?" It was so embarrassing.

sentences.zh: Jerry 也很笨手笨腳，打掃的時候常常把水桶踢翻。
sentences.en: Jerry was also clumsy and often knocked over the bucket when we cleaned the classroom.

sentences.zh: 校慶表演那天，他跳舞跳到一半跌倒，在全校面前出了糗。
sentences.en: At the school anniversary performance, he fell in the middle of his dance and made a fool of himself in front of the whole school.
sentences.hint: make a fool of oneself：oneself 要跟著主詞換，例如 he 寫 himself。

groups.name: 延伸字彙
groups.note: 同一個主題考過，這一題用不到，但值得認識

entries.zh: 搗蛋、惡作劇（get into mischief 調皮搗蛋）

essay.p1: The loudest sound I have ever heard in an English class came from my classmate Kai. It happened during a speaking lesson in our first year of senior high school. Kai was a quiet boy who seldom raised his hand.
essay.p2: That day, we were practicing a dialogue about seeing the school nurse. Kai played a sick student, and I was the nurse. He held his stomach and said, "I have a terrible stomachache." Just then, a loud noise came from him. Everyone knew what had happened: Kai had passed gas in front of the whole class. Then we all burst out laughing. Kai turned red, but he looked at me and said, "See? I'm not acting." Kai is still quiet, but we now know he can turn an awkward moment into a joke.

zh.p1: 我在英文課上聽過最響的一個聲音，是從我的同學阿凱那裡傳出來的。那是高一的一堂口說課上發生的事情。阿凱平常很安靜，很少舉手。
zh.p2: 那天我們在練習一段到健康中心看病的對話，阿凱演一個生病的學生，我演護理師。他抱著肚子說：「我肚子痛得不得了。」就在這個時候，他身上傳出很響的一聲。大家都知道發生了什麼事情：阿凱在全班面前放了一個屁。接著，我們全都大笑起來。阿凱臉都紅了，可是他看著我說：「你看，我不是在演。」阿凱到現在還是很安靜，不過我們現在都知道，他有辦法把尷尬的場面變成笑話。

basic.levels: 用字：三級只有 awkward（尷尬的）、gas（氣體；放屁的 pass gas）、senior（高年級的；senior high school 高中）、stomach（胃、肚子）四個，沒有四級以上的字。

upgrade.t: 用 the moment 開頭，再用 where 子句寫出聲音從哪裡來
upgrade.b: Just then, a loud noise came from him.
upgrade.m: The moment he finished, a loud noise came from where he was standing.
upgrade.why: 基礎版的 Just then（就在那時候）只說事情發生的時間。範文用 [The moment] + [he finished]，the moment 後面接子句，意思和 as soon as 一樣，是「他一說完，……就……」，讀者會知道聲音緊接在台詞後面出現，好笑的地方就在這裡。後半句的 from 後面接 [where he was standing]，where 子句說的是「他站著的那個地方」，整個子句當介系詞 from 的受詞，寫出聲音的來處，卻不必把話說破。

upgrade.t: 換更精確的動詞，再用 instead of 寫出他沒有做的事情
upgrade.b: Kai turned red, but he looked at me and said, "See? I'm not acting."
upgrade.m: Kai's face flushed with embarrassment, but instead of running back to his seat, he looked at me and said, "See? I'm not acting."
upgrade.why: turn red 說的是臉變紅，flush 也是臉紅，而且字典說明是因為強烈的情緒，所以 [face] + flushed + with + [embarrassment] 直接把「尷尬」這個原因寫了出來。後面的 [instead of] + [running back to his seat] 意思是「沒有跑回座位，反而……」，instead of 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 running。讀者先看到一般人會做的事情，再看到阿凱真正做的事情，他那句話就顯得更出人意料。

upgrade.t: since that day 配現在完成式，講到現在都是如此
upgrade.b: Kai is still quiet, but we now know he can turn an awkward moment into a joke.
upgrade.m: Kai is still quiet, but since that day, we have all known how quickly he can turn an awkward moment into a joke.
upgrade.why: 基礎版用 now 加現在式 know，只說現在知道。範文用 [since that day]（從那天起），since 後面接過去的時間點，主要子句就用現在完成式 [we] + have (all) + [known]，意思是從那天一直到現在都知道。know 後面接的 [how quickly he can …] 是 how 開頭的名詞子句，當 known 的受詞；多了 quickly，讀者就知道大家佩服的是他反應有多快。turn [A] into [B] 意思是「把 A 變成 B」，兩句都用到。

upgrade.t: 用 ask／choose + 人 + to V 寫出是誰安排的
upgrade.b: Kai played a sick student, and I was the nurse.
upgrade.m: Our teacher, Ms. Lin, asked Kai to play a student who felt sick, and she chose me to be the nurse.
upgrade.why: 基礎版直接說誰演什麼角色。範文多寫了是老師安排的，用了兩個相同的句型：[asked] + Kai + [to play …] 和 [chose] + me + [to be …]，也就是 [動詞] + [人] + to + [原形動詞]，to 後面寫的是要這個人去做的事情。a student who felt sick 用 who 子句代替形容詞 sick，說明這個學生「覺得身體不舒服」；Ms. Lin 前後加逗號，補充說明 Our teacher 是誰。

frames.name: 第一段（介紹這位同學，交代是什麼時候的事情）

items.f: The funniest thing I have ever seen in ___（哪一堂課或哪個場合） happened to my classmate ___（同學的名字）.
items.ex: The funniest thing I have ever seen in a PE class happened to my classmate Amy.

items.f: It happened during ___（什麼活動） when we were in ___（幾年級）.
items.ex: It happened during a school trip when we were in the fifth grade.

items.f: ___（同學的名字） was a ___（什麼樣的） boy／girl who ___（平常的樣子）.
items.ex: Ben was a serious boy who never laughed at our jokes.

items.f: Nobody expected ___（同學的名字） to ___（後來做的事情）.
items.ex: Nobody expected Ben to sing in front of the whole school.

frames.name: 第二段（寫出這件趣事的經過與大家的反應）

items.f: That day, we were ___（正在做什麼） when ___（突然發生的事情）.
items.ex: That day, we were taking a class photo when a bird landed on Amy's head.

items.f: As soon as ___（同學做了什麼）, ___（緊接著發生的事情）.
items.ex: As soon as Ben started to sing, the music stopped.

items.f: Everyone burst out laughing, and ___（同學自己的反應）.
items.ex: Everyone burst out laughing, and Amy laughed too.

items.f: Whenever we ___（什麼情況）, we still ___（大家現在會有的反應）.
items.ex: Whenever we hear that song, we still look at Ben and smile.

items.prompt: 請寫一篇英文作文，主題爲 “Weight Loss”：以你個人或你熟悉的人(朋友、親戚)爲例，說明造成這個人體重過重的原因，並提出你認爲理想的解決之道。
items.source: 大學入學考試中心 89 學年度學科能力測驗英文考科

essay.p1: My cousin Jun is in his last year of junior high, and in the past year, he has gained almost ten kilograms. After spending a few days with him, I found that the reasons were hidden in his daily routine. In the morning, he gets up so late that he has no time for breakfast, and by the second break, he is so hungry that he buys cookies and chocolate at the school store. After school, he takes the bus straight to his cram school. On the way, he picks up a large full-sugar bubble tea, and dinner is usually greasy fried chicken eaten at a long, narrow table in his cram school classroom. He does not get home until 9:30 p.m., and even then, he plays games on his phone until after midnight, with a bag of potato chips next to him. From morning to night, he hardly moves except to walk from one seat to the next.
essay.p2: The ideal solution, I believe, is not to make Jun go on a strict diet but to change the small habits that fill his day, one part of the day at a time. In the morning, his mother can prepare a simple breakfast the night before, such as a sandwich and a carton of milk, so that he no longer arrives at school hungry. After school, Jun can ride a YouBike to the cram school instead of taking the bus, and choose unsweetened tea and a lunch box with vegetables over bubble tea and fried chicken. At night, the most important change is to hand his phone to his parents at eleven and go to bed. Teenagers need eight to ten hours of sleep a night, and those who sleep too little are more likely to gain weight. None of these changes is hard on its own. If the whole family makes them together instead of scolding him, Jun will not feel that he is being punished, and he will be more likely to keep them up long after his exams are over.
essay.caveat:
這是一種寫法，不是標準答案。題目要求「文長120字左右」，這裡的「字」指的是英文單字（words），不是中文字數；91 學測起，原卷才寫成「120個單詞(words)」。這一年大考中心沒有公布評分說明，看不出多寫會不會扣分；本篇寫了 342 個單詞，篇幅與本題庫其他範文相近，是為了把每一個原因和對應的辦法都寫具體。
題目要做兩件事：說明造成體重過重的原因，再提出理想的解決之道。本篇以表弟為例，第一段說原因，第二段說辦法。原因沒有一條一條列出來，而是跟著表弟一天的作息帶出來：早上、放學後、晚上；第二段的辦法也照同樣的時間順序一一對應。這樣讀者不必另外記哪個辦法對應哪個原因，兩段放在一起就對得起來。
題目說的是「理想的」解決之道，所以本篇第二段第一句先表明立場：理想的做法不是節食，而是改掉幾個小習慣，最後再說明為什麼要全家一起改。第二段說青少年每晚需要睡八到十個小時，依據的是美國睡眠醫學會的建議；美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）也指出，睡眠不足的兒童與青少年，肥胖的風險比較高。這一年的題目沒有規定要分幾段，本篇分成兩段，是為了讓原因和辦法的分界清楚，不是題目的要求。同一份考卷的簡答題，考的正是一則兒童減重營的報導。大考中心自 98 年起才公布作文佳作，這一年沒有官方佳作可以對照。

zh.p1: 表弟阿俊今年國三，一年下來胖了快十公斤。我跟他相處了幾天，發現問題就出在他每天的作息。他早上總是起得太晚，沒時間吃早餐，到了第二節下課就餓得受不了，跑去福利社買餅乾、巧克力。放學後，他搭公車直奔補習班，路上先買一大杯全糖珍奶，晚餐多半是油膩膩的炸雞，就在補習班的長條桌上解決。晚上九點半才到家，他又拿起手機打電動，一打就打過半夜，手邊還放著一包洋芋片。一整天下來，除了從這張椅子換到那張椅子，他幾乎沒動過。
zh.p2: 我認為，理想的做法不是逼阿俊嚴格節食，而是順著他一天的作息，把幾個小習慣一個一個改過來。早上，他媽媽可以前一晚先把簡單的早餐準備好，像是一個三明治加一盒牛奶，他就不會餓著肚子上學。放學後，他可以騎 YouBike 去補習班，不必再搭公車；飲料改喝無糖茶，晚餐改吃有青菜的便當，不要再買珍奶、吃炸雞。晚上最要緊的，是十一點一到就把手機交給爸媽，上床睡覺。青少年每天晚上要睡八到十個小時，睡太少的人比較容易發胖。這些改變，每一項單獨來看都不難；要是全家一起改，而不是一直罵他，阿俊就不會覺得自己在受罰，就算會考考完很久了，也比較能繼續維持下去。

rubric.intro:
89 學測的英文作文，大考中心沒有公布評分說明，也沒有公布佳作，所以這一題沒有官方資料可以對照。題目本身的要求有三項：「文長120字左右」、主題為 “Weight Loss”，以及以你個人或你熟悉的人為例，說明造成這個人體重過重的原因，並提出你認為理想的解決之道。
下面的五項對照，借用大考中心從 95 學測起公布的評分項目，逐項說明範文怎麼寫；這五項不是 89 這一年公布的規定，所以這裡不寫配分。
rubric.keypoint:
題目要的是兩件事：原因與解決之道，兩者缺一不可；而且要「以一個人為例」，不是泛泛地談現代人為什麼會胖。所以原因要寫這個人自己的生活：他什麼時候吃了什麼、做了什麼、少做了什麼。
解決之道要能對上原因。寫了三個原因，卻只提出「多運動、少吃」這種對誰都適用的辦法，讀起來就像沒有回應前面的內容；每一個原因最好都有一個對應的辦法。題目還說「你認為理想的」，所以要表明自己的看法，並說出為什麼這樣最理想。
時態跟著內容走：這一年來胖了將近十公斤，一直延續到現在，用現在完成式（has gained）；我陪他幾天、發現原因，是已經發生的事，用過去式（found）；他每天的作息是現在的習慣，用現在式（gets up、buys、takes）；提出的辦法用 can、will 表示可以做到、將會如何。

mapping.t: 第一段先交代這個人：表弟阿俊國三，這一年來胖了將近十公斤。接著跟著他一天的作息說原因，每一個原因都有具體的細節：早上來不及吃早餐，第二節下課餓了就去福利社買餅乾和巧克力；放學搭公車直接去補習班，路上買一大杯全糖珍奶，晚餐是在補習班教室長條桌上吃的油膩炸雞；九點半才到家，玩手機遊戲到半夜，旁邊擺著一包洋芋片；最後一句總結他一整天幾乎都坐著。第二段先表明理想的做法是改習慣、不是節食，再照同樣的時段一一提出辦法：前一晚準備好早餐；騎 YouBike 去補習班，改選無糖茶和有青菜的便當；十一點把手機交給爸媽、上床睡覺，並說明睡太少比較容易變胖。最後說明為什麼要全家一起改：阿俊不會覺得自己在受罰，考完試以後也比較能持續。

第一段第一句點出這個人和問題（胖了將近十公斤），第二句 I found that the reasons were hidden in his daily routine 預告原因要從作息裡找；接著用 In the morning → After school → On the way → He does not get home until 9:30 p.m. 帶出原因，最後一句 From morning to night 把一整天收成一句。
第二段第一句 The ideal solution, I believe, is not … but … 先表明立場，再用和第一段同樣的時段帶出辦法：In the morning → After school → At night。第一段每一個原因，在第二段都找得到對應的辦法：沒吃早餐 → 前一晚準備早餐；搭公車、珍奶、炸雞 → 騎 YouBike、無糖茶、有青菜的便當；玩手機到半夜 → 十一點交出手機。倒數第二句 None of these changes is hard on its own 把所有辦法收在一起，最後一句說明為什麼要全家一起改，回到第一句所說的「理想」。

時態：這一年來的變化延續到現在，用現在完成式（has gained）；我陪他幾天、發現原因，用過去式（found、were hidden）；他每天的作息是現在的習慣，用現在式（gets up、buys、takes、plays）。
[After] spending a few days with him, I found …：介系詞 after 後面接 V-ing；spending 的主詞就是後面的 I。
he gets up [so] late [that] he has no time for breakfast：so + 副詞 + that 子句，意思是「……到……的程度」；後面的 he is so hungry that … 是同一個句型，用的是形容詞。
dinner is usually greasy fried chicken [eaten at a long, narrow table in his cram school classroom]：過去分詞片語修飾 chicken，等於 that is eaten at …；炸雞是吃的對象，所以用過去分詞。
He does [not] get home [until] 9:30 p.m.：not … until，意思是「直到……才……」。
[with] a bag of potato chips [next to him]：with + O + OC，這裡的 OC 是介系詞片語 next to him，說明他玩手機時的情形。
he [hardly] moves [except to walk] from one seat to the next：hardly 本身就是否定，意思是「幾乎不」；except 後面接不定詞，說明唯一的例外。
The ideal solution, [I believe], is [not] (to make Jun go on a strict diet) [but] (to change …)：I believe 插在句中，前後加逗號；not A but B 連接兩個不定詞片語，A 與 B 形式相同；make + O + 原形動詞。
the small habits [that fill his day]：關係子句修飾 habits。
[so that] he no longer arrives at school hungry：so that 表示目的；句尾的 hungry 說明他到學校時的狀態。
ride a YouBike to the cram school [instead of] taking the bus：instead of + V-ing。
[choose] unsweetened tea and a lunch box with vegetables [over] bubble tea and fried chicken：choose A over B，意思是「選 A 而不選 B」。
the most important change is [to] (hand his phone to his parents at eleven) and (go to bed)：不定詞片語當主詞補語，hand 和 go 共用 to。
[those who] sleep too little are more likely to gain weight：those who，意思是「……的人」；be likely to V，意思是「可能……」，more likely 表示比較可能。
[None] of these changes [is] hard on its own：none of 接複數名詞時，動詞用單數、複數都有人用，正式寫作多用單數，這裡用 is；on its own 意思是「單獨看」。
[If] the whole family [makes] them together instead of scolding him, Jun [will] not feel …：表示時間或條件的副詞子句，用現在式代替未來式。主要子句 Jun will not feel … 說的是將來，用 will；if 引導條件副詞子句，說的也是將來的事，卻用現在式 makes，不說 if the whole family will make。同樣的規則也適用於 when、before、until、as soon as、unless 引導的副詞子句。instead of 後面接 V-ing（scolding）。
he [is being] punished：先比較兩句。He is kind. 說的是他的個性，平常就是這樣；He is being kind. 說的是他此刻的表現，一時如此，平常不一定這樣。being 表示「此刻、這一陣子」的情形；後面接過去分詞，就成了被動語態的進行式（be being p.p.），意思是「正在……」。同樣地，He is punished whenever he is late. 說的是一般的情形（他只要遲到就會受罰）；He is being punished. 說的是此刻正在受罰。本句說的是全家一起改習慣的這段期間，阿俊不會覺得自己「正在受罰」，所以用 is being punished。
[keep] them [up]：keep something up，意思是「持續做下去」；受詞是代名詞時要放在 keep 和 up 中間，不說 keep up them。
he [will] be more likely to keep them up long [after] his exams [are] over：after 引導時間副詞子句，和前面的 if 子句一樣，說的是將來的事卻用現在式 are，不說 after his exams will be over；主要子句 he will be more likely … 才用 will。

全篇實詞逐字對過大考中心《高中英文參考詞彙表》：已標級數的詞形之中，一級 132、二級 20、三級 4、四級 2、六級 2，四級以上 4 個，占 160 個詞形的 2.5%，是 greasy（油膩的）、scolding（責罵，原形 scold）兩個四級字，以及六級的 cram（cram school 是補習班）、carton（紙盒；a carton of milk 是一盒牛奶）。三級的有 bubble、chips、junior、routine。
片語：gain weight（變胖）、daily routine（每天的作息）、get up（起床）、cram school（補習班）、a long, narrow table（長條桌）、pick up（順路買）、bubble tea（珍珠奶茶）、get home（到家）、go on a diet（節食）、a carton of（一盒）、ride a YouBike（騎 YouBike 微笑單車）、instead of（沒有……反而）、choose A over B（選 A 而不選 B）、go to bed（上床睡覺）、on one's own（單獨）、keep … up（持續下去）。desk 通常指一個人用的書桌；補習班教室裡好幾個人並排坐的長條桌，英文說 long table 或 long, narrow table 就清楚了。這一篇容易拼錯的是 kilograms、routine、breakfast、sandwich、unsweetened 這幾個。

89 這一年大考中心沒有公布評分說明；97 學測表 1 寫明，體例看的是格式、標點與大小寫。本題題目只給了主題 “Weight Loss”，考試時可以把 Weight Loss 寫在第一行當標題；本題庫的範文只列兩段正文。本篇要留意的有：句首的片語或子句後面加逗號（In the morning, 、After school, 、After spending a few days with him, ）；I believe 這類插入語前後都加逗號；時間寫成 9:30 p.m.，p.m. 用小寫加句點，是美式常見的寫法；a long, narrow table 的兩個形容詞都在描述桌子，順序可以對調，中間要加逗號；YouBike 是公共自行車的名稱，Y 與 B 都大寫，寫成一個字；full-sugar 是兩個字合起來放在名詞前當形容詞，中間加連字號。

wordBank.note: 條目取自本題庫的歷屆試題，缺口由本題庫補足；出處欄標示這個條目考過的年度與題號，練習句是本題庫依試題文體、針對這一題的情境寫的。先看中文自己寫寫看，想不出來再點提示，寫完再看參考答案。

groups.name: 活用型單字（Words for Production）
groups.note: 這一題要自己寫得出來的

entries.zh: 體重（gain weight 變胖；lose weight 減重）
例行公事、作息（daily routine 每天的作息）
entries.src: 115年學測 Q1、99年學測 Q8、83年推薦甄選 Q9

entries.zh: 不吃正餐（skip breakfast 不吃早餐）
營養（proper nutrition 適當的營養）
生活方式（a healthy lifestyle 健康的生活方式）

sentences.zh: 我爸爸這幾年體重過重，醫生要他減重。
sentences.en: My dad has been overweight for the past few years, and his doctor has told him to lose weight.

sentences.zh: 他每天的作息幾乎都是坐著：開車上班，在辦公室坐一整天，回家又坐在沙發上看電視。
sentences.en: His daily routine involves almost no movement: he drives to work, sits at his desk all day, and then sits on the sofa watching TV.

sentences.zh: 他工作忙，常常不吃早餐，中午也隨便吃。
sentences.en: Because he is busy, he often skips breakfast and grabs whatever he can for lunch.

sentences.zh: 加班到很晚的時候，他習慣吃宵夜，像是一碗泡麵。
sentences.en: When he works late, he usually has a late-night snack, such as a bowl of instant noodles.

sentences.zh: 他還很愛喝含糖飲料，一天至少一杯。
sentences.en: He also loves sugary drinks and has at least one a day.

sentences.zh: 公司附近的自助餐，菜色大多很油膩。
sentences.en: Most of the buffet-style restaurants near his office serve greasy food.

sentences.zh: 壓力一大，他的胃口反而變得更好。
sentences.en: When he is under stress, he seems to have a bigger appetite.

sentences.zh: 週末他喜歡一邊看棒球轉播，一邊吃垃圾食物。
sentences.en: On weekends, he likes to eat junk food while watching baseball games on TV.

sentences.zh: 他試過節食，可是不到一個禮拜就放棄了。
sentences.en: He tried going on a diet, but he gave up within a week.

sentences.zh: 我認為只靠少吃不夠，還要飲食均衡，讓身體得到適當的營養。
sentences.en: I believe eating less is not enough; he also needs a balanced diet that gives him proper nutrition.

sentences.zh: 最理想的做法，是全家一起過更健康的生活。
sentences.en: The ideal solution is for our whole family to adopt a healthier lifestyle together.

sentences.zh: 晚餐後我們可以一起去河濱公園快走，規律運動能幫他消耗熱量。
sentences.en: After dinner, we can take brisk walks in the riverside park; exercising regularly will help him burn calories.

sentences.zh: 在公司，他可以改走樓梯，不要搭電梯。
sentences.en: At work, he can take the stairs instead of the elevator.

sentences.zh: 最難的，是改掉吃宵夜的壞習慣。
sentences.en: The hardest part will be breaking his bad habit of eating late-night snacks.

sentences.zh: 只要堅持每天運動，他就能慢慢瘦下來，也能保持身材。
sentences.en: If he persists in exercising every day, he will slowly lose weight and stay fit.

groups.name: 延伸字彙
groups.note: 同一個主題考過，這一題用不到，但值得認識

entries.zh: 激烈的、需要大量體力的
entries.src: 110年學測 Q12、109年學測 Q14、108年指考 Q5、104年指考 Q4

essay.p1: My cousin Jun is in junior high, and he has gained almost ten kilograms this year. Because he gets up late, he has no time for breakfast and buys cookies at the school store. On the way to cram school, he picks up a bubble tea, and dinner is usually fried chicken. At night, he plays games on his phone until after midnight. He hardly moves all day.
essay.p2: I believe the ideal solution is to change his small habits. His mother can make breakfast the night before. Jun can ride a YouBike to cram school and choose unsweetened tea and a lunch box with vegetables. At eleven, he should give his phone to his parents and go to bed. If his family joins him, Jun will not feel that he is being punished.

zh.p1: 表弟阿俊在讀國中，今年胖了將近十公斤。因為他早上起得晚，沒時間吃早餐，就到福利社買餅乾吃。去補習班的路上，他會順便買一杯珍奶，晚餐通常是炸雞。到了晚上，他拿著手機打電動，一直打到過了半夜。也就是說，他一整天幾乎都沒有動。
zh.p2: 我認為理想的做法，是改掉他幾個小習慣。他媽媽可以前一晚先把早餐做好；至於阿俊自己，可以騎 YouBike 去補習班，飲料選無糖茶，再挑一個有青菜的便當。到了十一點，他就該把手機交給爸媽，上床睡覺。要是家人陪著他一起改，阿俊就不會覺得自己是在受罰。

basic.levels: 用字：三級只有 bubble（bubble tea 珍珠奶茶）、junior（junior high 是國中）兩個。cram 是六級，但 cram school（補習班）是學生天天講的複合詞，範文也這樣寫；unsweetened（無糖的）詞彙表沒有收，它是一級字 sweet 加上字首 un-（不）和字尾 -en、-ed，飲料店的「無糖」就是這個字；YouBike 是公共自行車的名稱。除此之外沒有四級以上的字。

upgrade.t: 用 so … that 把起床晚和沒吃早餐連成因果
upgrade.b: Because he gets up late, he has no time for breakfast and buys cookies at the school store.
upgrade.m: In the morning, he gets up so late that he has no time for breakfast, and by the second break, he is so hungry that he buys cookies and chocolate at the school store.
upgrade.why: 基礎版用 because 說明原因，意思清楚。範文改用 [主詞] + gets up + so + [副詞 late] + that + [結果子句]：so 說明晚到什麼程度，that 子句接著說出這個程度造成的結果，所以「起得太晚」和「沒時間吃早餐」一句就連起來了。後半句再用同一個句型 so hungry that …（so 後面這次接形容詞），加上 by the second break（到了第二節下課）這個時間點，讀者就看得出他是一路餓到下課才去買零食。

upgrade.t: 用 so that 說明辦法的目的，並加上具體的早餐
upgrade.b: His mother can make breakfast the night before.
upgrade.m: In the morning, his mother can prepare a simple breakfast the night before, such as a sandwich and a carton of milk, so that he no longer arrives at school hungry.
upgrade.why: 基礎版只說要準備早餐，沒說為什麼。範文先用 such as 舉出具體的早餐（a sandwich and a carton of milk），再用 [主要子句] + so that + [目的子句] 說明這樣做是為了什麼：so that 表示目的，後面接一個完整的子句，這裡講的是將來的事，子句裡用現在式 arrives 就可以。這樣一來，辦法就直接對上第一段「沒吃早餐、餓了買零食」的原因。

upgrade.t: 用 instead of 和 choose A over B 寫出換掉了什麼
upgrade.b: Jun can ride a YouBike to cram school and choose unsweetened tea and a lunch box with vegetables.
upgrade.m: After school, Jun can ride a YouBike to the cram school instead of taking the bus, and choose unsweetened tea and a lunch box with vegetables over bubble tea and fried chicken.
upgrade.why: 基礎版只寫出新的做法，讀者要自己回頭對照第一段，才知道換掉的是什麼。範文用兩個結構把舊習慣也寫出來：[新做法] + instead of + [V-ing 舊做法]，instead of 是介系詞，所以後面接動名詞 taking；choose + [A] + over + [B] 意思是「選 A 而不選 B」，A 是無糖茶和便當，B 是珍奶和炸雞。新舊放在同一句，辦法和原因的對應一眼就看得出來。

upgrade.t: 用 except to 把「幾乎不動」說得更精確
upgrade.b: He hardly moves all day.
upgrade.m: From morning to night, he hardly moves except to walk from one seat to the next.
upgrade.why: 兩句都用 hardly（幾乎不）。範文在後面加上 except + [to V]，說出唯一的例外：他只有從一個座位走到下一個座位的時候才會動。有了這個例外，「幾乎不動」就有了具體的畫面；句首的 From morning to night 也把第一段從早上、放學到晚上的作息收在一起。

frames.name: 第一段（以一個人為例，說明他體重過重的原因）

items.f: In the past ___（多久）, my ___（哪一個人） has gained ___（幾公斤）.
items.ex: In the past six months, my older sister has gained five kilograms.

items.f: ___（誰） ___（做什麼事情） so late that he／she ___（造成什麼結果）.
items.ex: My uncle works so late that he often eats instant noodles at midnight.

items.f: He／She often skips ___（哪一餐） and then ___（後來吃了什麼）.
items.ex: My sister often skips lunch and then eats a whole bag of chips in the afternoon.

items.f: He／She hardly exercises because ___（為什麼很少運動）.
items.ex: My father hardly exercises because he drives to work and sits at a desk all day.

frames.name: 第二段（提出你認為理想的解決之道）

items.f: I believe the best way to help ___（誰） is to ___（辦法）.
items.ex: I believe the best way to help my father is to go for a walk with him after dinner every evening.

items.f: ___（誰） can ___（好的做法） instead of ___（V-ing，原本的壞習慣）.
items.ex: My uncle can bring a lunch box from home instead of eating instant noodles late at night.

items.f: If ___（誰） ___（改掉什麼習慣，用現在式）, he／she will ___（會有什麼好結果）.
items.ex: If my sister eats lunch at noon, she will not feel so hungry in the afternoon.

items.f: This plan is ideal because ___（為什麼這個辦法最理想）.
items.ex: This plan is ideal because my father can do it with the whole family and does not need to spend any money.

items.prompt: 根據以上四則求職廣告，寫一篇英文作文。文分兩段：第一段寫出你認爲這四種工作中那一種對你而言是最好的工作，並說明理由；第二段則寫出四種工作中你最不可能選擇的工作，也說明理由。假如這四種工作你都不喜歡，則在第一段說明都不喜歡的理由，在第二段寫你喜歡什麼工作，並說明理由。
items.source: 大學入學考試中心 88 學年度學科能力測驗英文考科

essay.p1: Of the four jobs, the one I would choose is the tour guide position at Southeastern Travel Services. Going through the ad line by line, I found that it asks for almost exactly what I have. The ad asks for an outgoing personality. Last spring, when six students from our sister school in Japan visited us, I volunteered to show them around Taipei, and by the end of the day, we had followed one another on Instagram. Next on the list is a good knowledge of English. English was the only language we all shared, so I used it to explain how to add money to an EasyCard, which MRT line to take, and why stinky tofu smells so bad but tastes so good. The only education the ad requires is a high school diploma, which I will have in a year and a half. As for the duties, the job is to escort foreign visitors and help them get from place to place, and that is exactly what I did that day. I would love to be paid to do it every day.
essay.p2: The job I would be least likely to take is the marketing job in Ad A. When I picture myself doing it, three questions come to mind. Could I sell health products to people I know? My aunt sells health supplements for a direct selling company, and she keeps posting ads for them in our family LINE group. Most of my relatives have muted the group, and I would hate for my friends to do the same to me. Could I be as "aggressive" as the ad wants? I enjoy helping people find what they need, but I am not good at persuading them to buy things they do not need. Could I live on commissions? The ad boasts that the company has paid NT$3.5 billion in commissions in the US, yet it says nothing about how much an ordinary seller earns in a month. My answer to all three questions is no, so no matter how lucrative the job is, it is not the right one for me.
essay.caveat:
這是一種寫法，不是標準答案。題目要求「文長約120字」，這裡的「字」指的是英文單字（words），不是中文字數；91 學測起，原卷才寫成「120個單詞(words)」。這一年大考中心沒有公布評分說明，看不出多寫會不會扣分；本篇寫了 354 個單詞，篇幅與本題庫其他範文相近，是為了把每一個理由都寫具體。
題目規定文分兩段：第一段寫你認為最好的工作，第二段寫你最不可能選擇的工作，兩段都要說明理由。本篇第一段選 D 的導遊，理由是拿廣告上的條件一條一條對照自己：個性外向、英文好、高中學歷、工作內容，每一條都用接待日本交流學生那天的經歷來證明；第二段選 A 的行銷工作，換一個方式，用三個問自己的問句帶出理由，最後一句一起回答。廣告 D 還寫了 Good appearance，本篇沒有拿來當理由：對照條件時，挑自己拿得出事情來證明的寫就好。
題目也給了另一條路：四種工作都不喜歡的話，第一段說明為什麼都不喜歡，第二段寫自己喜歡什麼工作。走這條路也可以，但兩段的內容要照題目的順序寫。這一題是 88 學年度（1999 年）的考題，所以廣告上才會有傳真履歷、打電話約面試這些做法；同一份考卷的簡答題，考的正是這四則廣告。大考中心自 98 年起才公布作文佳作，這一年沒有官方佳作可以對照。

zh.p1: 四種工作裡，我會選東南旅行社的導遊。我把廣告一行一行看下來，發現它要的條件，我幾乎都有。廣告要找個性外向的人。去年春天，日本姊妹校有六個學生來我們學校交流，我自告奮勇帶他們逛台北，一天下來，大家已經互相追蹤 IG 了。接下來一條是英文要好。那天我們唯一共通的語言就是英文，我就用英文告訴他們悠遊卡怎麼加值、該搭哪一條捷運線，還有臭豆腐為什麼聞起來那麼臭、吃起來卻那麼香。學歷方面，廣告只要求高中畢業，再過一年半，我就拿到畢業證書了。至於工作內容，這份工作是陪外國旅客四處參觀、幫他們打點交通，而這正是我那天做的事情。要是每天做這件事還有錢領，我求之不得。
zh.p2: 我最不可能選的，是 A 廣告的行銷工作。只要想像自己做這份工作，心裡就會冒出三個問題。我能把保健產品賣給認識的人嗎？我阿姨在一家直銷公司賣保健食品，常常在家族 LINE 群組裡貼產品廣告，親戚大多已經把群組設成靜音；我可不希望朋友也這樣對我。我能像廣告要求的那樣「積極強勢」嗎？我喜歡幫別人找到他們需要的東西，卻不擅長說服別人買他們用不到的東西。我能靠抽佣金過日子嗎？廣告誇口說這家公司在美國已經發出新台幣三十五億元的佣金，一般業務員一個月能賺多少，卻一個字也沒提。這三個問題，我的答案都是不能；所以這份工作就算再好賺，也不適合我。

rubric.intro:
88 學測的英文作文，大考中心沒有公布評分說明，也沒有公布佳作，所以這一題沒有官方資料可以對照。題目本身的要求有三項：「文長約120字」、文分兩段，以及根據四則求職廣告，第一段寫出你認為最好的工作並說明理由，第二段寫出你最不可能選擇的工作並說明理由（四種都不喜歡的話，第一段說明理由，第二段寫你喜歡的工作）。
下面的五項對照，借用大考中心從 95 學測起公布的評分項目，逐項說明範文怎麼寫；這五項不是 88 這一年公布的規定，所以這裡不寫配分。
rubric.keypoint:
題目要的是兩件事，而且各有各的段落：第一段寫最好的工作，第二段寫最不可能選的工作，兩段都要說明理由。理由最好從廣告本身出發：廣告寫了資格、工作內容和待遇，拿這些條件對照自己的個性、能力和經驗，理由才有根據，不會只是一句「我喜歡」或「我不喜歡」。
理由要具體。說自己個性外向、英文不錯，最好舉一件真正發生過的事來證明；說不想做某個工作，也要講出是廣告上的哪一點讓你卻步。
時態跟著內容走。我現在並沒有真的要去應徵這些工作，選哪一份、做不做得到都只是假設，屬於與現在事實相反的假設：動詞倒推一個時態，will 變成 would、can 變成 could，所以寫 the one I would choose、the job I would be least likely to take，問自己做不做得到也用 Could I …?。至於廣告上寫的條件，那是現在的事實，用現在式（asks for、requires）；接待交流學生那天是過去的事，用過去式（visited、volunteered、used），到那天結束時已經完成的事，用過去完成式（had followed）。

mapping.t: 第一段先說出選擇：東南旅行社的導遊，再用一句話交代理由從哪裡來：廣告要的條件，我幾乎都有。接著逐條對照：廣告要個性外向，就講去年春天自願帶日本姊妹校六個學生逛台北，一天下來互相追蹤 IG；廣告要英文好，就講用英文教他們悠遊卡怎麼加值、搭哪一條捷運線，還解釋臭豆腐；廣告只要求高中學歷，一年半後就拿得到；最後連工作內容都正是那天做過的事情。第二段先說出最不可能選的是 A 的行銷工作，再用三個問句帶出理由：能不能把產品賣給認識的人（阿姨在家族 LINE 群組貼直銷廣告，親戚大多設成靜音）；能不能像廣告要的那樣 aggressive（喜歡幫人找需要的東西，不擅長說服人買用不到的東西）；能不能靠佣金過活（廣告只誇公司發出多少佣金，沒說一般業務員一個月賺多少）。最後一句回答三個問題，收回結論。

第一段第一句 Of the four jobs, the one I would choose is … 直接回答題目，第二句 Going through the ad line by line, … 預告理由要從廣告裡一條一條找；接著照廣告的條件依序帶出理由：The ad asks for an outgoing personality → Next on the list is a good knowledge of English → The only education the ad requires is … → As for the duties, …。每一條都是先引廣告、再講自己。
第二段第一句同樣直接回答題目，第二句 three questions come to mind 預告理由的形式；三個理由都用 Could I …? 開頭，後面緊接著回答。最後一句 My answer to all three questions is no 把三個問題收在一起，再用 so 帶出結論。兩段都是先講選擇、再講理由，讀者一看就知道每一段在回答題目的哪一個部分。

時態：選工作是假設的事，用 would；廣告上的條件用現在式（asks for、requires）；交流那天的事用過去式（visited、volunteered、used）；到那天結束時已經完成的事，用過去完成式（had followed）。
本篇的 [would] 和 [could] 都是假設語氣。題目問的是「如果要你選」，我現在並沒有真的去應徵這些工作，所以是與現在事實相反的假設；動詞倒推一個時態，will 變成 would，can 變成 could。if 子句沒有寫出來，the one I would choose is … 等於 If I had to choose one of the four jobs, I would choose …；第二段的 Could I sell health products to people I know? 等於「要是我去做這份工作，我能把保健產品賣給認識的人嗎？」。I would love to …、I would hate for … 也是同一個道理。
[Of] the four jobs, the one [I would choose] is …：of 表示「在……之中」；the one 代替前面說過的 job，I would choose 是省略了 that 的關係子句。
[Going through] the ad line by line, I found …：分詞構句，going 的主詞就是後面的 I。
[by the end of the day], we [had followed] one another on Instagram：by the end of the day 意思是「到那天結束時」，在那之前已經完成的事，用過去完成式。
explain (how to add money to an EasyCard), (which MRT line to take), and (why stinky tofu smells so bad but tastes so good)：explain 後面接三個並列的受詞，前兩個是「疑問詞 + 不定詞」，第三個是 why 引導的名詞子句。smell、taste 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞（bad、good），不接副詞。
a high school diploma, [which] I will have in a year and a half：非限定關係子句，which 前面加逗號，補充說明 diploma；in a year and a half 意思是「再過一年半」。
the job is [to] (escort foreign visitors) and (help them get from place to place)：不定詞片語當主詞補語，escort 和 help 共用 to；help + O + 原形動詞。
I would love [to be paid] to do it every day：be paid to V，意思是「做某件事有錢領」。
the job I would be [least likely to] take：be likely to V 意思是「可能……」，least likely 是「最不可能」。
When I [picture] myself [doing] it：picture + O + V-ing，意思是「想像某人正在做某事」。
she [keeps posting] ads：keep + V-ing，意思是「一直、老是」。
I [would hate for] my friends [to] do the same to me：would hate for + 人 + to V，意思是「很不希望某人做某事」；Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary 收有 I'd hate for all this to go to waste 這個例句。不加 for，說 would hate my friends to do … 也可以。
Could I be [as] "aggressive" [as] the ad wants?：as + 原級 + as，稱為原級比較，也有人叫同等比較，意思是「和……一樣」。兩個 as 中間放形容詞或副詞的原級，不放比較級；這裡是 be 動詞後面的形容詞 aggressive，所以不寫 more aggressive。
I enjoy [helping] people [find] what they need, but I am not good at [persuading] them [to] buy …：enjoy + V-ing；help + O + 原形動詞；be good at + V-ing；persuade + O + to V。
Could I [live on] commissions?：live on，意思是「靠……過活」。
The ad boasts that …, [yet] it says nothing about [how much an ordinary seller earns in a month]：yet 連接語氣相反的兩句；how much 引導的名詞子句當 about 的受詞，用直述句的語序，不說 how much does an ordinary seller earn。
[no matter how] lucrative the job is：no matter how + 形容詞 + 主詞 + 動詞，意思是「不管多麼……」；也可以說 however lucrative the job is。

全篇逐字對過大考中心《高中英文參考詞彙表》：已標級數的詞形之中，一級 121、二級 17、三級 3、四級 4、五級 1、六級 5，四級以上 10 個，占 151 個詞形的 6.6%。四級是 aggressive（積極強勢的）、boast（誇口）、diploma（畢業證書）、volunteer（自願）；五級是 commission（佣金）；六級是 escort（陪同）、lucrative（賺錢的）、mute（設成靜音）、outgoing（外向的）、supplement（補充品；health supplements 是保健食品）。其中 aggressive、diploma、escort、lucrative、outgoing、commission 都是廣告上原本就有的字，讀懂廣告，就等於先拿到這幾個字。三級的有 ad、persuade、product。詞彙表沒有收 seller（sell 加 -er）與 stinky。
片語：tour guide（導遊）、sister school（姊妹校）、show sb around（帶某人參觀）、by the end of the day（一天下來）、follow sb on Instagram（在 IG 上追蹤某人）、add money to an EasyCard（悠遊卡加值）、stinky tofu（臭豆腐）、high school diploma（高中畢業證書）、get from place to place（到處移動）、direct selling（直銷）、health supplements（保健食品）、live on（靠……過活）。這一篇容易拼錯的是 personality、knowledge、diploma、aggressive、commissions、lucrative 這幾個。

88 這一年大考中心沒有公布評分說明；97 學測表 1 寫明，體例看的是格式、標點與大小寫。本題沒有給標題，本題庫的範文只列兩段正文。本篇要留意的有：句首的片語或子句後面加逗號（Last spring, 、Going through the ad line by line, 、As for the duties, ）；非限定關係子句前面加逗號（a high school diploma, which …）；aggressive 是借用廣告上的字，所以加引號；錢數寫成 NT$3.5 billion；公司、學校、品牌與專有名詞開頭大寫：Southeastern Travel Services、EasyCard、MRT、LINE、Instagram；Ad A 的 A 是廣告的代號，也大寫。

wordBank.note: 條目取自本題庫的歷屆試題，缺口由本題庫補足；出處欄標示這個條目考過的年度與題號，練習句是本題庫依試題文體、針對這一題的情境寫的。先看中文自己寫寫看，想不出來再點提示，寫完再看參考答案。

sentences.zh: 要是四份工作只能挑一份，我會去應徵英文報社的記者。
sentences.en: If I could pick only one of the four jobs, I would apply for the reporter position at the English newspaper.
sentences.hint: apply for 後面接職位或工作，例如 apply for a job、apply for the position。

sentences.zh: 我知道自己現在還不符合所有的條件，因為這份工作要大學學歷。
sentences.en: I know I don't meet all the requirements yet, because the job calls for a college degree.
sentences.hint: 「符合條件」的動詞用 meet（也可以用 fulfill），不說 reach。

sentences.zh: 不過，等我大學畢業，我相信我會具備這份工作要的資格。
sentences.en: Still, by the time I graduate from college, I believe I will have the qualifications the job asks for.

sentences.zh: 我英文說得很流利，中文讀寫當然也沒有問題。
sentences.en: I'm fluent in English, and of course I have no trouble reading and writing Chinese.

sentences.zh: 這份工作的工時有彈性，一週只要上三十個小時。
sentences.en: The job offers flexible hours, and I would only need to work 30 hours a week.

sentences.zh: 記者為了跑突發新聞，工時常常不固定，可是我覺得這正是這份工作有挑戰性的地方。
sentences.en: Reporters often work irregular hours to cover breaking news, but to me, that is exactly what makes the job challenging.

sentences.zh: 記者還得天天趕截稿時間，壓力一定很大。
sentences.en: Reporters also have to race against deadlines every day, so they must be under a lot of pressure.

sentences.zh: 遇到不想受訪的人，記者也得想辦法說服對方開口。
sentences.en: When people do not want to be interviewed, reporters have to find ways to persuade them to talk.

sentences.zh: 除了薪水，報社每年還發年終獎金，也有員工旅遊之類的福利。
sentences.en: Besides a salary, the newspaper pays a year-end bonus and offers benefits such as an annual company trip.
sentences.hint: benefits 指薪水以外的福利，這個意思常用複數。

sentences.zh: 我希望將來能在新聞界發展。
sentences.en: I hope to pursue a career in journalism someday.
sentences.hint: journalism 是新聞業、新聞工作；新聞報導本身是 news。

sentences.zh: D 的導遊工作只要高中文憑，可是我的個性一點都不外向。
sentences.en: The tour guide job in Ad D only requires a high school diploma, but I am not outgoing at all.

sentences.zh: 比起整天帶外國旅客參觀景點，我寧可坐在書桌前寫稿。
sentences.en: I would rather write at my desk than show foreign visitors around tourist spots all day.
sentences.hint: would rather A than B：A、B 都用原形動詞。

sentences.zh: 我表哥賣汽車，領的是佣金，有時候一個月賺很多，有時候幾乎沒收入。
sentences.en: My cousin sells cars and works on commission, so some months he earns a lot, and some months he earns almost nothing.
sentences.hint: work on commission：收入照業績算，介系詞用 on。

sentences.zh: 記者的薪水不算高，但對我來說，能做自己喜歡的事情比較重要。
sentences.en: A reporter's salary isn't very high, but to me, doing work I enjoy matters more.

sentences.zh: B 的技術人員待遇也許不錯，可是我對電子產品完全不懂。
sentences.en: The service technician job in Ad B may be well-paid, but I know next to nothing about electronics.

groups.name: 延伸字彙
groups.note: 同一個主題考過，這一題用不到，但值得認識

entries.src: 98年學測 Q14、97年指考 Q4、96年學測 Q12、89年學測 Q8

essay.p1: The tour guide job in Ad D is the best one for me. It requires an outgoing personality and a good knowledge of English, and I have both. When six students from our Japanese sister school visited us, I showed them around Taipei. I explained in English how to add money to an EasyCard and which MRT line to take. That is exactly what a tour guide does.
essay.p2: I would be least likely to take the marketing job in Ad A. My aunt sells health products for a direct selling company and keeps posting ads in our family LINE group. Most of my relatives ignore them, and I would hate for my friends to do the same to me. The ad wants aggressive people, but I am not good at persuading others to buy things.

zh.p1: 對我來說，D 廣告的導遊工作是最好的一份。這份工作要求個性外向、英文程度好，這兩項我都有。日本姊妹校有六個學生來我們學校的時候，我帶他們逛了台北，用英文告訴他們悠遊卡怎麼加值、該搭哪一條捷運線，而這正是導遊在做的事情。
zh.p2: 我最不可能選的，是 A 廣告的行銷工作。我阿姨在一家直銷公司賣保健產品，常常在家族的 LINE 群組裡貼廣告。親戚大多不理會這些廣告，我可不希望朋友也這樣對我。至於廣告要找的，是積極強勢的人，可是我不擅長說服別人買東西。

basic.levels: 用字：三級有 ad（廣告）、persuade（說服）、product（產品）三個。四級的 aggressive（積極強勢的）和六級的 outgoing（外向的）都是廣告上原本就有的字，讀懂廣告就能直接拿來用；marketing（行銷）也是廣告上的字，詞彙表沒有另外收，所以照樣使用。EasyCard（悠遊卡）、MRT（捷運）、LINE 是專有名詞，範文也這樣寫。實用句型例句裡的 technician（技術員）、electronics（電子學）同樣取自 B 廣告。

upgrade.t: 用 Of 框出範圍，再用省略 that 的關係子句說出選擇
upgrade.b: The tour guide job in Ad D is the best one for me.
upgrade.m: Of the four jobs, the one I would choose is the tour guide position at Southeastern Travel Services.
upgrade.why: 基礎版直接寫 [主詞] + is + the best one for me。範文先用 [Of] the four jobs 框出範圍，of 在這裡是「在……之中」，用來從同一類的幾樣東西裡挑出一個，範文把它放在句首，先告訴讀者是在四份工作裡挑。接著 the one [I would choose] 裡，one 代替前面說過的 job，I would choose 是省略了 that 的關係子句：關係代名詞當子句裡動詞的受詞時，常常可以省略。用 would，是因為我並沒有真的要去應徵，這只是想像中的選擇。

upgrade.t: 用 volunteer to V 和過去完成式加上具體細節
upgrade.b: When six students from our Japanese sister school visited us, I showed them around Taipei.
upgrade.m: Last spring, when six students from our sister school in Japan visited us, I volunteered to show them around Taipei, and by the end of the day, we had followed one another on Instagram.
upgrade.why: 範文多交代了兩件事情。一是 [volunteered] + [to V]，意思是「自願去做某件事」，比單純寫 showed 多了「主動」的意思，正好證明自己個性外向。二是句尾的 [by the end of the day], we [had followed] one another on Instagram：by 是「不晚於、到……為止」，到那天結束時已經完成的事情，就用過去完成式 had + 過去分詞。互相追蹤 IG 這個細節，讓讀者看得到大家一天下來就變熟了。

upgrade.t: explain 後面並列三個疑問詞開頭的受詞
upgrade.b: I explained in English how to add money to an EasyCard and which MRT line to take.
upgrade.m: English was the only language we all shared, so I used it to explain how to add money to an EasyCard, which MRT line to take, and why stinky tofu smells so bad but tastes so good.
upgrade.why: explain 後面可以接 how、which、why 這類疑問詞帶出的受詞。範文寫成 explain + (how to add money …), (which MRT line to take), and (why stinky tofu smells …)，前兩個是「疑問詞 + 不定詞」，第三個是 why 子句，三個都當 explain 的受詞，用逗號和 and 串起來。smell、taste 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞 bad、good。句首的 English was the only language we all shared 則先交代為什麼要用英文。

upgrade.t: 換更精確的動詞，並用現在完成式
upgrade.b: Most of my relatives ignore them, and I would hate for my friends to do the same to me.
upgrade.m: Most of my relatives have muted the group, and I would hate for my friends to do the same to me.
upgrade.why: ignore 是「不理會」，只說親戚不看那些廣告；範文的 mute 原本是「把聲音關掉」，用在 LINE 這類通訊軟體上，就是把某個聊天室的通知關掉：訊息還是會進來，只是不會再跳出來提醒，所以 muted the group 把親戚的反應寫得更精確，也更像真實生活。動詞用現在完成式 [主詞] + have + [過去分詞]，表示過去做了這個動作，結果延續到現在：群組到現在還是靜音。mute 是六級字，寫不出來的時候，用 ignore 也完全正確。

frames.name: 第一段（說出最好的工作，並說明理由）

items.f: Of the four jobs, the ___（哪一則廣告的什麼工作） would be the best one for me because ___（主要理由）.
items.ex: Of the four jobs, the reporter job in Ad C would be the best one for me because I love writing.

items.f: The ad asks for ___（廣告上的一項條件）, and ___（自己符合這項條件的證明）.
items.ex: The ad asks for a strong command of English, and English has always been my best subject.

items.f: When ___（過去發生的一件事情）, I ___（自己做了什麼）, so I know I can ___（這份工作要做的事情）.
items.ex: When our school basketball team won a big game, I interviewed the players and wrote a short report for the school newspaper, so I know I can write news stories.

items.f: I would also enjoy ___（V-ing，廣告上的工作條件或待遇） because ___（原因）.
items.ex: I would also enjoy working only 30 hours a week because I could take classes at night.

frames.name: 第二段（說出最不可能選的工作，並說明理由）

items.f: The job I would be least likely to take is the ___（哪一則廣告的什麼工作）.
items.ex: The job I would be least likely to take is the service technician job in Ad B.

items.f: The ad requires ___（廣告上的條件）, but ___（自己做不到的地方）.
items.ex: The ad requires a degree in electronics, but science has always been my weakest subject.

items.f: I would not want to ___（這份工作要做的事情） because I would miss ___（V-ing，自己喜歡做的事情）.
items.ex: I would not want to repair machines all day because I would miss talking with people.

items.f: Although ___（這份工作的好處）, the job is not right for me because ___（真正的原因）.
items.ex: Although the company offers training, the job is not right for me because I am not interested in machines.

items.prompt: 每個人在不同的情況下對雨可能有不同的感受。請寫一篇短文，敘述你在某一個下雨天的實際經歷或看到的景象，並據此敘述你對雨的感覺。
items.source: 大學入學考試中心 87 學年度學科能力測驗英文考科

essay.p1: Summer rain in Taipei rarely surprises anyone; an afternoon can turn into a thunderstorm in minutes. The one I remember best broke just as I stepped out of the MRT station after school. Above the exit, rain drummed on the metal roof so loudly that I could hardly hear the traffic. Hoping to rent one of the raingo umbrellas, I hurried to the stand by the door, only to find it empty. Even if one had been left, it would not have helped me: I am not even old enough to sign up for the app, let alone rent an umbrella. With nowhere else to go, I took shelter under the arcade with a dozen other pedestrians. What had been a busy street was now a shallow river, and the air smelled of wet dust and scooter exhaust. That was when a delivery rider in a yellow raincoat turned onto the crosswalk. The moment his back wheel touched the painted stripes, it slid, and down went the rider and his scooter. Two men rushed out to help him up. Instead of looking at his knee, though, the rider opened the box on the back to check the food. Only when he saw that the soup had not spilled did he limp back to his seat and ride off into the rain.
essay.p2: Until that afternoon, rain had been nothing but a nuisance to me: soaked shoes, crowded buses, and umbrellas that were always gone when I needed one. Watching the rider, I realized that for some people, a rainy day is not a reason to stay indoors but the busiest part of their job. Every meal that arrives dry at someone's door has been carried through the same slippery streets. Getting wet is still not something I enjoy, but what I do when the rain comes has changed. These days, if my family wants to order dinner on a stormy evening, I offer to walk to the noodle shop around the corner with my own umbrella. It is a small thing. Still, whenever rain drums on a roof now, I picture the rider checking his soup before his knee, and I feel grateful to the people who keep working while the rest of us wait for the rain to stop.
essay.caveat:
這是一種寫法，不是標準答案。題目要求「文長以120字左右為原則」，這裡的「字」指的是英文單字（words），不是中文字數；91 學測起，原卷才寫成「120個單詞(words)」。這一年大考中心沒有公布評分說明，看不出多寫會不會扣分；本篇寫了 379 個單詞，篇幅與本題庫其他範文相近，是為了把那一天的經過和自己的感覺都寫具體。
題目要做兩件事：先敘述某一個下雨天的實際經歷或看到的景象，再「據此」敘述你對雨的感覺。本篇第一段寫經歷，場景用聲音、畫面、氣味帶出來：雨打在鐵皮屋頂上的聲音、變成一條河的馬路、濕灰塵和機車廢氣的味道，再寫外送員在斑馬線上滑倒。第二段寫感覺，不列點，而是落在一個具體的改變上：下大雨的晚上不叫外送，自己帶傘去買。這樣第二段的感覺是從第一段的經歷來的，正好回應題目的「據此」。
北捷全線各站設有 raingo 共享傘的租借站，但年滿 18 歲才能自己申請租借，所以範文裡的高中生就算傘架上還有傘，也沒辦法自己租。這一年的題目沒有規定要分幾段，本篇分成兩段，是為了讓經歷和感覺的分界清楚，不是題目的要求。同一份考卷的簡答題是短詩閱讀，考的是 Langston Hughes 的 April Rain Song，寫的也是雨。大考中心自 98 年起才公布作文佳作，這一年沒有官方佳作可以對照。

zh.p1: 台北的夏天，午後常常一下子就變成雷陣雨，大家早就見怪不怪了。我記得最清楚的那一場，是我放學剛走出捷運站的時候，嘩啦啦下起來的。雨打在出口上方的鐵皮屋頂上，聲音大到我幾乎聽不到外面的車聲。我想租一把 raingo 共享傘，趕快跑到門口的傘架那裡，結果一把都不剩。其實就算還有傘也沒用，我年紀還不夠，連 App 都不能註冊，更不用說租傘了。沒地方可去，我只好跟十幾個路人擠在騎樓下躲雨。剛剛還車來車往的馬路，這時已經變成一條淺淺的小河，空氣裡都是濕灰塵和機車廢氣的味道。就在這時候，一個穿黃色雨衣的外送員騎上斑馬線，後輪一壓到白色標線就打滑，整個人連車倒在地上。旁邊兩個男人馬上衝過去把他扶起來。可是他沒有先看自己的膝蓋，反而先打開後座的箱子，看看餐點有沒有怎樣。一直到確定湯沒有灑出來，他才一跛一跛地坐回車上，騎進雨裡。
zh.p2: 在那天下午以前，下雨對我來說就只是麻煩：鞋子濕透、公車擠得要命，需要傘的時候，傘總是沒了。看著那個外送員，我才明白，對有些人來說，下雨天不是待在家裡的理由，反而是工作最忙的時候。每一份乾乾爽爽送到家門口的餐點，都是有人冒著雨、騎過一樣濕滑的馬路送來的。我到現在還是不喜歡淋雨，不過下雨天我的做法已經不一樣了。現在要是遇到下大雨的晚上，家人說想叫外送，我會說我自己帶傘，走去巷口的麵店買就好。這只是件小事，但現在只要聽到雨打在屋頂上的聲音，我就會想起那個先看湯、才看膝蓋的外送員，也會很感謝那些在我們等雨停的時候，還在外面工作的人。

rubric.intro:
87 學測的英文作文，大考中心沒有公布評分說明，也沒有公布佳作，所以這一題沒有官方資料可以對照。題目本身的要求有兩項：「文長以120字左右為原則」，以及敘述你在某一個下雨天的實際經歷或看到的景象，並據此敘述你對雨的感覺。
下面的五項對照，借用大考中心從 95 學測起公布的評分項目，逐項說明範文怎麼寫；這五項不是 87 這一年公布的規定，所以這裡不寫配分。
rubric.keypoint:
題目要的是兩件事：一件是某一個下雨天的經歷或景象，一件是你對雨的感覺，而且感覺要「據此」寫出來，也就是從那一天的經歷來的。只寫「我喜歡下雨，因為很涼快」，卻說不出是哪一天、發生了什麼事，就沒有回應題目；反過來，經歷寫得很完整，最後卻沒有交代對雨的感覺，也只完成了一半。
經歷要寫成一個場景，不是一句「那天雨很大」。聽到什麼、看到什麼、聞到什麼，寫出一兩樣，讀者就像站在現場；再挑一件真正讓你印象深刻的事情寫清楚，第二段的感覺才有根據。
時態跟著內容走：那一天的經歷是過去的事，用過去式（broke、hurried、slid、opened）；在那之前已經發生的事，用過去完成式（had been a busy street、had not spilled）。「就算還剩一把傘也沒用」是與過去事實相反的假設，動詞倒推一個時態，用過去完成式與 would have p.p.。現在的感覺和習慣是現在的事，用現在式（is、offer、picture）；從那天到現在的改變，用現在完成式（has changed）。

mapping.t: 第一段先說台北夏天的午後雷陣雨很平常，再帶出自己記得最清楚的那一場：放學剛走出捷運站，雨就下來了。接著用三種感官帶出場景：雨打在鐵皮屋頂上的聲音大到聽不見車聲；趕到共享傘的傘架，卻一把都不剩，就算還有，自己不滿 18 歲，連 App 都不能註冊，更別說租傘；十幾個路人擠在騎樓下，馬路變成一條河，空氣裡是濕灰塵和機車廢氣的味道。然後寫最重要的一件事：外送員在斑馬線上滑倒，兩個人衝過去把他扶起來，他先看的不是膝蓋，而是湯有沒有灑出來。第二段先說以前下雨只是麻煩（鞋子濕透、公車很擠、傘總是沒了），再說看到外送員以後明白的事情：下雨天對有些人來說是工作最忙的時候。最後把感覺落在一個具體的改變上：下大雨的晚上自己帶傘去買，不叫外送；聽到雨聲就會想起那個外送員，也感謝在雨中工作的人。

第一段先用一句台北夏天常下午後雷陣雨，帶出記得最清楚的那一場，再照時間往下走：剛走出車站就下雨 → 趕到傘架卻一把都不剩 → 躲到騎樓下 → 外送員滑倒 → 他先看湯，再騎進雨裡。場景的細節依序用聲音（rain drummed on the metal roof）、畫面（What had been a busy street was now a shallow river）、氣味（the air smelled of wet dust and scooter exhaust）帶出來。最重要的那件事用 That was when 帶出來，讀者就知道重點到了。
句子的開頭也有變化，不是每一句都用「主詞 + 過去式」起頭：有一般敘述開頭（Summer rain in Taipei rarely surprises anyone）、地點片語開頭（Above the exit）、分詞構句開頭（Hoping to …）、介系詞片語開頭（With nowhere else to go）、名詞子句當主詞（What had been …）、連接詞開頭（The moment …），也有倒裝（down went …、Only when … did he …）。
第二段第一句 Until that afternoon 接回第一段那一天，先講以前的感覺；Watching the rider, I realized … 是轉折點；Getting wet is still not something I enjoy, but … has changed 先承認沒變的，再說變了的；These days 帶出現在的做法；最後一句 Still, whenever rain drums on a roof now 呼應第一段的雨聲，首尾對得起來。

時態：那一天的經歷用過去式（broke、hurried、slid、opened）；在那之前已經發生的事，用過去完成式（had been a busy street、had not spilled）；Until that afternoon, rain had been … 講的是到那天下午為止一直如此，也用過去完成式；現在的感覺和習慣用現在式（is、offer、picture）；從那天到現在的改變，用現在完成式（has changed）。
(Summer rain in Taipei rarely surprises anyone)[;] (an afternoon can turn into a thunderstorm in minutes)：分號連接兩個意思緊密相關的完整句子，中間不用連接詞；後半句說明前半句為什麼不稀奇。rarely 本身就是否定，意思是「很少」；turn into 意思是「變成」；in minutes 意思是「幾分鐘之內」。
The one [I remember best] broke [just as] I stepped out of the MRT station after school：the one 指前一句的 thunderstorm，後面的 I remember best 是省略了 that 的關係子句，意思是「我記得最清楚的那一場」；just as 意思是「正當……的時候」，兩件事幾乎同時發生。
[Above the exit], rain drummed on the metal roof [so] loudly [that] I could [hardly] hear the traffic：地點片語放在句首，先交代位置；so + 副詞 + that 子句，意思是「……到……的程度」；hardly 本身就是否定，意思是「幾乎不」。
[Hoping] to rent one of the raingo umbrellas, I hurried to the stand by the door, [only to find] it empty：Hoping … 是分詞構句，hope 的主詞就是後面的 I，意思是「因為想……」；only to V 表示出乎意料、令人失望的結果，意思是「沒想到卻……」；find + O + 形容詞，意思是「發現……是……」。
[Even if] one [had been] left, it [would not have helped] me：與過去事實相反的假設，動詞倒推一個時態，if 子句用過去完成式，主要子句用 would have p.p.。那天傘架其實是空的，所以是和過去的事實相反。
I am [not even] old enough to (sign up for the app), [let alone] (rent an umbrella)：let alone 用在否定句後面，意思是「更別說……」。前面先說一件比較容易、卻已經做不到的事情（註冊 App），let alone 後面接一件更難的事情（租傘），前者做不到，後者當然更不可能。Longman 的例句是 The baby can't even sit up yet, let alone walk!，順序也是先易後難。let alone 前後兩部分形式相同，這裡都是原形動詞片語。
[old enough to] sign up：形容詞 + enough to V，意思是「夠……可以……」，enough 放在形容詞後面。
[With nowhere else to go], I [took shelter] under the arcade：with + 受詞 + to V 交代當時的情況，意思是「沒有別的地方可去」；take shelter 意思是「躲雨、避難」。
[What had been a busy street] was now a shallow river：what 引導的名詞子句當主詞，意思是「原本是……的地方」。what 子句裡用過去完成式，說的是在那之前原本的樣子；主要動詞 was now 說的是那一刻的樣子。
[That was when] a delivery rider in a yellow raincoat turned onto the crosswalk：That was when + 子句，意思是「就在那時候……」，把接下來的事當成重點帶出來。
[The moment] his back wheel touched the painted stripes, it slid：the moment 當連接詞用，意思和 as soon as 一樣，是「一……就……」。
[down went] (the rider and his scooter)：表示方向的副詞 down 放在句首，主詞是名詞時，動詞移到主詞前面，讀起來更生動。主詞如果是代名詞就不倒裝，要說 down they went，不說 down went they。
Two men rushed out [to help] him [up]：不定詞表示目的；help + O + up，意思是「把某人扶起來」。
[Instead of looking] at his knee, [though], the rider opened the box on the back [to check] the food：instead of + V-ing，意思是「沒有……，反而……」；though 放在句中當副詞，意思是「不過、可是」，和前一句好心人衝過去扶他的畫面形成對比；to check 表示目的。
[Only when] he saw that the soup had not spilled [did he limp] back to his seat：only when 放在句首，主要子句要倒裝，助動詞 did 移到主詞 he 前面，後面接原形動詞 limp。倒裝在主要子句，不在 only when 帶的子句裡，所以前半的 he saw 維持直述句語序。
[Until] that afternoon, rain [had been] [nothing but] a nuisance to me: soaked shoes, crowded buses, and umbrellas …：until 意思是「直到……為止」，到那天下午為止一直如此，所以用過去完成式；nothing but 等於 only，意思是「只不過是」；冒號後面接說明，列出是哪些麻煩。
a rainy day is [not] (a reason to stay indoors) [but] (the busiest part of their job)：not A but B，意思是「不是 A，而是 B」，A 與 B 都是名詞片語。
Every meal [that arrives dry at someone's door] [has been carried] through the same slippery streets：關係子句修飾 meal；every 後面接單數名詞，動詞用單數 has；餐點不會自己走，是外送員把它送過來，所以用現在完成式的被動語態 has been carried（have been + p.p.）。arrives dry 的 dry 說明餐點送到時的狀態。
[Getting wet] is still not [something I enjoy]：動名詞片語當主詞，視為單數，動詞用 is；something I enjoy 是省略了 that 的關係子句。
[what I do when the rain comes] has changed：what 引導的名詞子句當主詞，視為單數，動詞用 has。
[These days], [if] my family wants to order dinner on a stormy evening, I [offer to] walk to the noodle shop：these days 意思是「現在、近來」，配現在式說現在的習慣；offer to V，意思是「主動說要做某事」。
[Still], [whenever] rain drums on a roof now, I [picture] the rider [checking] his soup before his knee：still 放在句首當副詞，意思是「儘管如此」，承接前一句的 It is a small thing；whenever 意思是「每當」；picture + O + V-ing，意思是「想像、腦中浮現某人正在做某事」。
I feel [grateful to] the people [who keep working] while the rest of us [wait for] the rain [to stop]：grateful to + 人，意思是「感謝某人」；keep + V-ing，意思是「持續、繼續」；wait for + O + to V，意思是「等某人或某事物做某事」。

全篇逐字對過大考中心《高中英文參考詞彙表》：已標級數的詞形之中，一級 149、二級 24、三級 8、四級 4、五級 3、六級 1，四級以上 8 個，占 189 個詞形的 4.2%。四級是 exhaust（廢氣；scooter exhaust 是機車廢氣）、grateful（感謝的）、shelter（遮蔽；take shelter 是躲雨、避難）、stripe（條紋；斑馬線上的白色標線）；五級是 nowhere（沒有地方）、pedestrian（行人）、soak（濕透，這裡用 soaked 當形容詞）；六級是 limp（一跛一跛地走）。三級的有 dust、indoors、onto、rush、shallow、slippery、spill、stormy。詞彙表沒有收 arcade、crosswalk、nuisance、thunderstorm。
片語：turn into（變成）、in minutes（幾分鐘之內）、after school（放學後）、sign up for（註冊）、take shelter（躲雨）、go down（倒下）、rush out（衝出去）、help sb up（把某人扶起來）、ride off（騎走）、nothing but（只不過是）、stay indoors（待在室內）、these days（現在、近來）、offer to V（主動說要）、around the corner（在附近、巷口）、keep V-ing（持續）、wait for … to V（等……）。騎樓英文可以說 arcade 或 covered walkway；delivery rider 是外送員。這一篇容易拼錯的是 thunderstorm、pedestrians、exhaust、shallow、grateful 這幾個。

87 這一年大考中心沒有公布評分說明；97 學測表 1 寫明，體例看的是格式、標點與大小寫。本題沒有給標題，本題庫的範文只列兩段正文。本篇要留意的有：兩個完整句子意思緊密相關、中間不用連接詞時，可以用分號連接，分號後面小寫（Summer rain in Taipei rarely surprises anyone; an afternoon can …）；句首的片語或子句後面加逗號（Above the exit, 、With nowhere else to go, 、Until that afternoon, 、These days, 、Still, ）；插在句中的 though 前後都加逗號（Instead of looking at his knee, though, the rider …）；冒號後面接的是說明前一句的內容（it would not have helped me: I am not even old enough …；a nuisance to me: soaked shoes, …），冒號後面不必大寫；三項並列用 A, B, and C，最後一項前加逗號（soaked shoes, crowded buses, and umbrellas …）；MRT 全大寫；raingo 是品牌名稱，照品牌本身的寫法用小寫；someone's 的所有格用撇號。

wordBank.note: 條目取自本題庫的歷屆試題，缺口由本題庫補足；出處欄標示這個條目考過的年度與題號，練習句是本題庫依試題文體、針對這一題的情境寫的。先看中文自己寫寫看，想不出來再點提示，寫完再看參考答案。

groups.name: 活用型單字（Words for Production）
groups.note: 這一題要自己寫得出來的

entries.zh: （雨）下得很大（It is pouring. 正在下大雨）
預報、預測（the weather forecast 氣象預報）
entries.src: 109年指考補考 Q4、105年指考 Q8
102年學測 Q1、97年學測 Q14、92年學測 Q7
98年學測 Q13、87年推薦甄選 Q8

entries.zh: 使恢復精神（feel refreshed 神清氣爽）

sentences.zh: 每年五、六月是台灣的梅雨季，雨一下常常就是好幾天。
sentences.en: Every May and June, Taiwan has its plum rain season, and the rain often goes on for days.
sentences.hint: 梅雨季的英文，中央社、Taipei Times 等台灣的英文媒體寫 the plum rain season；中央氣象署的英文新聞稿用的是氣象學的名稱 Mei-yu season。

sentences.zh: 氣象預報說，運動會那天會有雷陣雨。
sentences.en: The weather forecast said there would be thunderstorms on our school's sports day.

sentences.zh: 果然，學校把運動會延到下個禮拜。
sentences.en: Sure enough, the school postponed the sports day until the following week.
sentences.hint: postpone + N + until／to + 時間：把某事延到某個時候。

sentences.zh: 早上還只是毛毛雨，到了放學的時候，已經下起傾盆大雨。
sentences.en: In the morning, it was only drizzling, but by the time school was over, it was pouring.
sentences.hint: It is pouring. 就是「正在下大雨」，不必再加 rain。

sentences.zh: 我忘了帶傘，在回家的路上淋到雨。
sentences.en: I had forgotten my umbrella, so I got caught in the rain on my way home.
sentences.hint: 「遇到下雨」說 be／get caught in the rain，caught 不能省，也不說 meet the rain。

sentences.zh: 我和同學跑到公車站躲雨。
sentences.en: My classmate and I ran to a bus stop to take shelter from the rain.

sentences.zh: 等到公車來，我們兩個已經全身濕透了。
sentences.en: By the time the bus came, we were both soaked to the skin.
sentences.hint: 只是淋濕寫 get wet 就好；soaked to the skin 是連裡面的衣服都濕透。

sentences.zh: 人行道上到處是水窪，磁磚又濕又滑，我差點跌倒。
sentences.en: The sidewalk was full of puddles, and the tiles were so slippery that I almost fell.

sentences.zh: 空氣又濕又悶，制服都黏在背上。
sentences.en: The air was hot and humid, and my uniform stuck to my back.

sentences.zh: 梅雨季的時候，衣服晾了兩天還是濕濕的。
sentences.en: During the plum rain season, clothes can hang for two days and still feel damp.

sentences.zh: 天空灰濛濛的，我的心情也跟著沉悶起來。
sentences.en: The sky was gray and gloomy, and so was my mood.

sentences.zh: 運動會延期，又淋了一身濕，我那天整個晚上心情都不好。
sentences.en: With the sports day postponed and my clothes soaking wet, I was in a bad mood all evening.

sentences.zh: 下雨天到哪裡都得帶傘，真的很麻煩。
sentences.en: Having to carry an umbrella everywhere on rainy days is a real nuisance.
sentences.hint: 動名詞片語當主詞，動詞用單數 is。

sentences.zh: 洗完熱水澡，我窩在房間裡，聽著雨滴滴答答地打在窗戶上。
sentences.en: After a hot shower, I curled up in my room and listened to the patter of rain on the window.

sentences.zh: 我捧著一杯熱可可，覺得房間裡暖暖的，好舒服。
sentences.en: Holding a cup of hot cocoa, I felt warm and cozy in my room.

sentences.zh: 第二天早上雨停了，空氣很清新，我覺得神清氣爽。
sentences.en: By the next morning, the rain had stopped, and the fresh air made me feel refreshed.
sentences.hint: refresh 是「讓人恢復精神」；人當主詞要寫 feel refreshed。

sentences.zh: 這讓我想起幾年前那場乾旱，水庫幾乎見底。
sentences.en: It reminded me of the drought a few years ago, when the reservoirs almost ran dry.

sentences.zh: 那時候有些縣市缺水缺得很嚴重，還得分區輪流停水。
sentences.en: At that time, some cities faced such a serious water shortage that they had to cut off the water supply to different areas on different days.

groups.name: 延伸字彙
groups.note: 同一個主題考過，這一題用不到，但值得認識

essay.p1: Just as I left the MRT station after school, it started to rain hard. The rain on the metal roof above the exit was so loud that I could hardly hear the traffic. I ran to the umbrella stand, but it was empty. Then a delivery rider in a yellow raincoat fell when his scooter slid on the wet road. Instead of looking at his knee, he opened the box on the back to check the food.
essay.p2: To me, rain used to mean wet shoes and crowded buses. Now I know a rainy day is the busiest time for some workers. On rainy nights, I walk to the noodle shop instead of ordering dinner online. Whenever I hear rain on a roof, I remember that rider and appreciate people who work in the rain.

zh.p1: 那天放學，我剛走出捷運站，雨就嘩啦嘩啦地下了起來。雨打在出口上方的鐵皮屋頂上，聲音大到我幾乎聽不到外面的車聲。我跑到傘架那裡，可是上面一把傘都沒有。就在這時候，有個穿黃色雨衣的外送員，機車在濕滑的馬路上打滑，整個人摔倒在地上。他沒有先看自己的膝蓋，反而先打開後座的箱子，看看餐點有沒有怎樣。
zh.p2: 以前對我來說，下雨就代表鞋子會濕、公車會很擠。現在我才知道，對有些工作的人來說，下雨天反而是最忙的時候。遇到下雨的晚上，我會自己走去麵店買晚餐，不上網叫外送。每次只要聽到雨打在屋頂上，我就會想起那個外送員，也很感謝那些在雨中工作的人。

basic.levels: 用字：全篇都是一、二級的字，沒有三級以上的字。rider 詞彙表沒有收，它是一級的 ride 加 -er，delivery rider 是外送員，範文也這樣寫，所以照樣使用。MRT（捷運）是專有名詞，範文也這樣寫。

upgrade.t: 地點片語放句首，換用更生動的動詞 drum
upgrade.b: The rain on the metal roof above the exit was so loud that I could hardly hear the traffic.
upgrade.m: Above the exit, rain drummed on the metal roof so loudly that I could hardly hear the traffic.
upgrade.why: 基礎版用 [The rain on the metal roof above the exit] 當主詞，主詞很長，讀到 was 才知道要說什麼。範文把地點 [Above the exit] 移到句首，主詞只剩 rain；把副詞性的片語移到句首，是為了先把焦點放在它上面。動詞也從 was 換成 drummed，寫出雨像打鼓一樣打在屋頂上的聲音，Cambridge 的例句 The rain drummed loudly on the roof 就是這個用法。動詞換成 drummed 以後，修飾它的要用副詞，所以寫 so loudly，不再用形容詞 so loud，句型是 [so + 形容詞／副詞] + that + [結果]。

upgrade.t: 用分詞構句和 only to 寫出「沒想到卻……」
upgrade.b: I ran to the umbrella stand, but it was empty.
upgrade.m: Hoping to rent one of the raingo umbrellas, I hurried to the stand by the door, only to find it empty.
upgrade.why: 範文把「想租傘」這個原因寫成分詞構句 [Hoping to rent …], [I] hurried …，放在句首；分詞 Hoping 的動作者必須是主要子句的主詞，這裡想租傘的人就是 I。句尾的 [only to + 原形動詞] 表示緊接著發生、出乎意料又令人失望的結果；find + [受詞] + [形容詞] 意思是「發現……是……」，形容詞前面一定要有受詞 it。這樣「本來想租傘」和「傘架是空的」放在同一句，期待落空的感覺比用 but 連接更明顯。

upgrade.t: 用過去完成式和冒號，把以前的感覺講具體
upgrade.b: To me, rain used to mean wet shoes and crowded buses.
upgrade.m: Until that afternoon, rain had been nothing but a nuisance to me: soaked shoes, crowded buses, and umbrellas that were always gone when I needed one.
upgrade.why: 基礎版的 [used to + 原形動詞] 說的是過去常常如此，通常帶有「現在已經不是這樣」的意思，可是沒有說從什麼時候開始改變。範文用 Until that afternoon 把時間點講清楚，到那天下午為止一直如此，所以用過去完成式 had been，也就是「到過去某個時間點為止」的時態。[nothing but] 等於 only，意思是「只不過是」；冒號後面再列出 (soaked shoes), (crowded buses), and (umbrellas …) 三項，說明是哪些麻煩。

upgrade.t: 用 picture 寫出腦中的畫面，再加上對比
upgrade.b: Whenever I hear rain on a roof, I remember that rider and appreciate people who work in the rain.
upgrade.m: Still, whenever rain drums on a roof now, I picture the rider checking his soup before his knee, and I feel grateful to the people who keep working while the rest of us wait for the rain to stop.
upgrade.why: 基礎版的 I remember that rider 只說想起那個人；範文用 [picture] + [受詞] + [V-ing]，讓讀者看到腦中浮現的是他先看湯、才看膝蓋的那一幕。後半的 [grateful to] + [人] 是「感謝某人」，[keep] + [V-ing] 是「持續做某事」，[while] + [子句] 是「在……的同時」，拿「我們在等雨停」和「他們還在工作」對比，比只寫 people who work in the rain 更有畫面。

frames.name: 第一段（敘述某一個下雨天的經歷或看到的景象）

items.f: I still remember the rainy ___（早上／下午等時間） when ___（那天發生的事情）.
items.ex: I still remember the rainy morning when our class trip was canceled.

items.f: The rain was so ___（形容詞） that I could not ___（做不到的事情）.
items.ex: The rain was so heavy that I could not see the bus stop across the street.

items.f: When I ___（做了什麼）, I saw ___（什麼人） ___（V-ing，正在做什麼）.
items.ex: When I got off the bus, I saw a little boy dancing in the rain with his father.

items.f: Instead of ___（V-ing，一般人會做的事情）, ___（什麼人） stopped to ___（停下來做的事情）.
items.ex: Instead of running to the bus stop, my classmate stopped to help an older man pick up his oranges.

frames.name: 第二段（根據這次經歷說出對雨的感覺）

items.f: Before that day, rain always made me feel ___（形容詞，以前的感覺）.
items.ex: Before that day, rain always made me feel lazy.

items.f: After that day, I began to see rain as ___（名詞，雨對你的新意義）.
items.ex: After that day, I began to see rain as a chance to slow down.

items.f: Now, whenever it rains, I ___（現在下雨時的做法）.
items.ex: Now, whenever it rains, I keep an extra umbrella in my school bag for friends who forget theirs.

items.f: Rain still ___（雨帶來的麻煩）, but it also ___（雨帶來的好處）.
items.ex: Rain still makes my shoes wet, but it also gives farmers the water they need.

items.prompt: 你同意 “Laughter is better than medicine” 這種說法嗎？以你自己或親朋好友的經驗或你所知道的故事爲例，加以說明。你的論點無論是正面或是反面都不會影響你的得分。
items.source: 大學入學考試中心 86 學年度學科能力測驗英文考科

essay.p1: Anyone who has swallowed a spoonful of bitter medicine would love to believe that laughter is better than medicine. There is some truth in the saying. A good laugh can lift a heavy mood, and it makes a long day in bed feel much shorter. People who stay cheerful when they are ill also seem to get well sooner than those who lie in bed complaining. Still, I cannot agree that laughter is better than medicine. However hard we laugh, laughter cannot kill a virus or bring down a high fever; only the right medicine can do that. What laughter can do is make the medicine easier to take, and that is something my little brother taught me when he caught the flu.
essay.p2: My brother is nine, and his fever climbed to 39°C on the first night. The doctor at the clinic near our home prescribed a powder that had to be mixed with water three times a day. One sip was enough for him. He pushed the cup away, shut his mouth tight, and refused to try again, no matter how patiently Mom begged. Watching from the doorway, I had an idea. Every day after school, he watches the same cartoon, and he knows every line of its hero by heart. So I tied his blanket around my neck as a cape, put on the hero's squeaky voice, and announced that I had come on a secret mission. By the time I tripped over my own cape, he was laughing so hard that he forgot he was sick. Once he calmed down, I told him that the mission was to finish the cup in three gulps. Holding his nose, he did exactly that, and then he asked whether the hero could come back at dinner. The next morning, his fever was gone. It was the medicine, not my show, that brought his fever down, but without the laughter, the medicine might have stayed in the cup. Laughter, in other words, is not better than medicine; it is the best partner that medicine can have.
essay.caveat:
這是一種寫法，不是標準答案。題目要求「文長以120字左右為原則」，這裡的「字」指的是英文單字（words），不是中文字數；91 學測起，原卷才寫成「120個單詞(words)」。這一年大考中心沒有公布評分說明，看不出多寫會不會扣分；本篇寫了 346 個單詞，篇幅與本題庫其他範文相近，是為了把立場和例子都寫具體。
題目要做兩件事：先表明同不同意 “Laughter is better than medicine” 這種說法，再用自己或親朋好友的經驗、或是你知道的故事來說明。題目也寫明，站在正面或反面都不會影響得分。本篇站在反面，但不是說笑沒有用：第一段先承認這句話有幾分道理，再說明為什麼不同意；第二段用弟弟得流感、不肯吃藥的經過，說明笑幫得上忙的地方在哪裡，最後把立場收在「笑不是比藥好，而是藥最好的搭檔」。
同一份考卷的簡答題短文，談的也是這句話：心情愉快的人病好得比較快，古時候的智者常說笑是最好的藥，甚至比藥還好。本篇第一段承認的那幾分道理，就是從這裡來的。這一年的題目沒有規定要分幾段，本篇分成兩段，是為了讓立場和例子的分界清楚，不是題目的要求。大考中心自 98 年起才公布作文佳作，這一年沒有官方佳作可以對照。

zh.p1: 吃過一匙苦藥的人，大概都很希望「笑比藥好」是真的。這句話確實有幾分道理。好好笑一場，沉重的心情會輕鬆起來，躺在床上的漫長一天也會覺得短得多。生病的時候保持開朗的人，好像也比躺在床上一直抱怨的人好得快。不過，我還是不同意笑比藥好。不管我們笑得多厲害，笑都殺不死病毒，也沒辦法讓高燒退下來；能做到這些的，只有對的藥。笑能做到的，是讓藥比較容易吃下去。這一點，是我弟弟得流感的時候教會我的。
zh.p2: 我弟弟九歲，第一天晚上就燒到 39 度。家附近診所的醫生開了藥粉，一天三次，每次都要加水泡開來喝。弟弟只喝了一口就不要了，他把杯子推開，嘴巴閉得緊緊的，不管媽媽多有耐心地拜託他，他就是不肯再喝。我站在房門口看著，突然想到一個辦法。弟弟每天放學都看同一部卡通，裡面主角的每一句台詞他都背得出來。於是我把他的毯子綁在脖子上當披風，學主角尖尖細細的聲音，宣布我帶著一個祕密任務來找他。等到我自己踩到披風、跌了一跤，他已經笑得連自己生病都忘了。他笑完、平靜下來以後，我跟他說，任務就是三口把那杯藥喝完。他捏著鼻子，真的三口就喝光了，喝完還問主角晚餐的時候能不能再來。第二天早上，他就退燒了。讓他退燒的是藥，不是我的表演；可是要是沒有那一陣笑，那杯藥可能一口都沒少。換句話說，笑並沒有比藥好，笑是藥最好的搭檔。

rubric.intro:
86 學測的英文作文，大考中心沒有公布評分說明，也沒有公布佳作，所以這一題沒有官方資料可以對照。題目本身的要求有兩項：「文長以120字左右為原則」，以及表明你同不同意 “Laughter is better than medicine” 這種說法，並用自己或親朋好友的經驗、或是你知道的故事來說明。
下面的五項對照，借用大考中心從 95 學測起公布的評分項目，逐項說明範文怎麼寫；這五項不是 86 這一年公布的規定，所以這裡不寫配分。
rubric.keypoint:
題目問的是「你同不同意」，所以第一段就要讓讀者知道你站在哪一邊，不能寫到最後才看得出來。題目還要求舉例，例子要寫出經過，讀者才看得到你的論點從哪裡來；只寫一句「我奶奶很愛笑，所以很健康」，還不算說明。
選反面，不等於說笑沒有用。先承認這句話有道理（There is some truth in the saying），再說明為什麼還是不同意（Still, I cannot agree …），立場反而更有說服力。題目裡的 better than 是比較，本篇抓住的就是這一點：笑有用，但不是比藥「更」有用。
時態跟著內容走：表明立場、說一般的道理，用現在式（is、seem、cannot）；弟弟現在每天看卡通，也是現在式（watches、knows）；生病那幾天的經過是過去的事，用過去式（climbed、pushed、tripped）；在那之前已經發生的事，用過去完成式（had come）；和過去事實相反的推測，用 might have p.p.（might have stayed）。

mapping.t: 第一段先用一句吃過苦藥的人都懂的話，帶出題目那句話，再承認它有幾分道理：好好笑一場，心情會輕鬆起來，躺在床上的日子也過得比較快；生病時開朗的人，病好像也好得比較快。接著表明不同意：笑殺不死病毒，也退不了高燒，只有對的藥做得到；笑能做到的，是讓藥比較容易吃下去。第二段用弟弟的經過說明：九歲的弟弟得了流感，燒到 39 度，只喝一口就不肯再喝很苦的藥粉；「我」學他每天看的卡通主角，把毯子綁在脖子上當披風，用主角的聲音宣布帶來祕密任務，結果自己踩到披風跌了一跤，把他逗得大笑；等他笑完、平靜下來，才跟他說任務是三口喝完那杯藥，他捏著鼻子喝光了。第二天早上就退燒了。最後回到立場：讓他退燒的是藥，可是沒有那一陣笑，那杯藥可能一口都沒少；笑不是比藥好，而是藥最好的搭檔。

第一段照「承認 → 轉折 → 立場 → 帶出例子」往下走：Anyone who … 帶出題目那句話；There is some truth in the saying 先讓步；Still, I cannot agree … 轉到自己的立場；What laughter can do is … 說清楚笑的位置；最後一句 that is something my little brother taught me … 預告第二段的例子，兩段就接起來了。
第二段照時間寫經過：發燒 → 不肯喝藥 → 想到辦法 → 扮卡通主角 → 笑完喝藥 → 第二天早上退燒，最後兩句回到第一段的立場。句子的開頭也有變化，不是每一句都用「主詞 + 過去式」起頭：有名詞子句當主詞（What laughter can do）、however 帶出的讓步子句（However hard we laugh）、分詞構句（Watching from the doorway、Holding his nose）、時間子句（By the time …、Once he calmed down）、分裂句（It was the medicine, not my show, that …），也有插入語（Laughter, in other words, is …）。
最後一句 Laughter, in other words, is not better than medicine 回到題目的那句話，首尾對得起來。

時態：表明立場、說一般的道理用現在式（is、seem、cannot）；弟弟現在的習慣也用現在式（watches、knows）；生病那幾天的經過用過去式（climbed、pushed、tripped）；在宣布之前就已經「來了」，用過去完成式（had come）；和過去事實相反的推測，用 might have p.p.（might have stayed）。
[Anyone who has swallowed a spoonful of bitter medicine] [would love to] believe that …：who has swallowed … 是關係子句，修飾 anyone，整串當主詞；現在完成式 has swallowed 表示「有過……的經驗」；would love to V，意思是「很想……」。
it [makes] a long day in bed [feel] [much] shorter：make + O + 原形動詞，意思是「讓……」；much 修飾比較級 shorter，意思是「……得多」。
People [who stay cheerful when they are ill] also [seem to] get well sooner than [those] [who lie in bed complaining]：seem to V，意思是「似乎……」；those 代替前面的 people；lie in bed complaining 的 complaining 是分詞，說明躺著的時候在做什麼。
[Still], I cannot agree that laughter is better than medicine：still 放在句首當副詞，意思是「儘管如此」，承接前面的讓步，轉到自己的立場。
[However hard] we laugh, laughter cannot kill a virus or bring down a high fever：however + 形容詞或副詞 + 主詞 + 動詞，意思和 no matter how 一樣，是「不管多……」；這裡的 however 不是「然而」，所以後面不加逗號。Collins 詞典的例句是 However we adopt healthcare reform, it isn't going to save major amounts of money.
(laughter cannot kill a virus or bring down a high fever)[;] (only the right medicine can do that)：分號連接兩個意思緊密相關的完整句子，中間不用連接詞；後半句說明能做到的是什麼。
[What laughter can do] is [make] the medicine [easier to take]：what 引導的名詞子句當主詞，把重點放在 is 後面；what 子句裡有 do 的時候，be 動詞後面可以直接接原形動詞，Cambridge 的文法說明舉的例子是 What we need to do is get new batteries for it。make + O + 形容詞，意思是「使……變得……」；easier to take 意思是「比較容易吃下去」。
a powder [that had to be mixed] with water：關係子句修飾 powder；藥粉不會自己泡開，是有人加水把它泡開，所以用被動語態 had to be + p.p.。
One sip was [enough for] him：enough for + 人，意思是「對某人來說就夠了」，這裡是說喝一口他就受不了了。
He (pushed the cup away), (shut his mouth tight), [and] (refused to try again)：三個動作並列，用 A, B, and C；shut … tight 的 tight 說明嘴巴閉緊的樣子。
[no matter how] patiently Mom begged：no matter how + 副詞 + 主詞 + 動詞，意思是「不管……多……」，和前面的 however hard 意思一樣；一篇裡用兩種說法，讀起來不重複。
[Watching from the doorway], I had an idea：分詞構句，watch 的主詞就是後面的 I。
Every day after school, he [watches] the same cartoon, and he knows every line of its hero [by heart]：弟弟到現在還是天天看，是現在的習慣，所以用現在式；by heart 意思是「背下來」。
So I tied his blanket around my neck [as] a cape, [put on] the hero's squeaky voice, and announced that I [had come] on a secret mission：as 意思是「當作」；put on a voice 意思是「裝出某種聲音」；「來」發生在宣布之前，所以用過去完成式 had come；come on a mission 意思是「帶著任務來」。
[By the time] I tripped over my own cape, he [was laughing] [so] hard [that] he forgot he was sick：by the time 意思是「等到……的時候」；過去進行式 was laughing 表示那一刻他正在笑；so + 副詞 + that 子句，意思是「……到……的程度」。
[Once] he calmed down, I told him that …：once 當連接詞用，意思是「等到……之後、一旦……」。
[Holding his nose], he did exactly that, and then he asked [whether] the hero could come back at dinner：分詞構句；hold one's nose 意思是「捏著鼻子」；whether 引導的名詞子句當 asked 的受詞，間接問句用直述句的語序（the hero could come back），不寫成 could the hero come back。
[It was] the medicine, not my show, [that] brought his fever down：分裂句 It was … that …（也有人稱為強調句），把要強調的 the medicine 放在中間；not my show 插在中間，說明不是什麼。bring down 的受詞是名詞時，可以放在 down 前面或後面（bring down a high fever、brought his fever down）。
[without] the laughter, the medicine [might have stayed] in the cup：without 在這裡等於「如果沒有……」，是和過去事實相反的假設，所以主要子句用 might have p.p.，意思是「當時可能就會……」。
Laughter, [in other words], is not better than medicine[;] it is the best partner [that medicine can have]：in other words 意思是「換句話說」，插在主詞和動詞之間，前後加逗號；分號前後是兩個完整句子，後句說明前句；that medicine can have 是關係子句，修飾 partner。

全篇逐字對過大考中心《高中英文參考詞彙表》：已標級數的詞形之中，四級以上 4 個：virus（病毒）四級、doorway（門口）五級、prescribe（開藥，這裡用 prescribed）五級、cape（披風）六級。三級的有 announce、bitter、cheerful、clinic、complain、laughter、mission、powder、sip、tight。詞彙表沒有收 gulp（一大口）與 squeaky（聲音尖細的）；spoonful（一匙的量）是二級的 spoon 加上 -ful。
片語：would love to V（很想）、lift a mood（讓心情好起來）、get well（病好）、bring down（使降下來）、catch the flu（得流感）、three times a day（一天三次）、push away（推開）、no matter how（不管多麼）、by heart（背下來）、put on a voice（裝出某種聲音）、trip over（絆到……而跌倒）、calm down（平靜下來）、hold one's nose（捏著鼻子）、in other words（換句話說）。這一篇容易拼錯的是 laughter、prescribed、patiently、squeaky、announced 這幾個。

86 這一年大考中心沒有公布評分說明；97 學測表 1 寫明，體例看的是格式、標點與大小寫。本題沒有給標題，本題庫的範文只列兩段正文。本篇要留意的有：兩個完整句子意思緊密相關、中間不用連接詞時，可以用分號連接，分號後面小寫（… bring down a high fever; only the right medicine …；… not better than medicine; it is the best partner …）；句首的片語或子句後面加逗號（Still, 、Watching from the doorway, 、Every day after school, 、Holding his nose, 、The next morning, ）；插在句中的 in other words 與 not my show 前後都加逗號；三項並列用 A, B, and C，最後一項前加逗號（pushed …, shut …, and refused …；tied …, put on …, and announced …）；Mom 當稱呼用，像名字一樣大寫；hero's 的所有格用撇號；溫度寫成 39°C，也可以寫成 39 degrees Celsius。

wordBank.note: 條目取自本題庫的歷屆試題，缺口由本題庫補足；出處欄標示這個條目考過的年度與題號，練習句是本題庫依試題文體、針對這一題的情境寫的。先看中文自己寫寫看，想不出來再點提示，寫完再看參考答案。
